exercises.pose_description: Sit on the floor with legs extended in front of you, back straight and core engaged. Keep your hands beside you or reaching forward slightly.
exercises.end_pose_description: The feet are strongly flexed at the ankles, with the toes pulled back as far as possible towards the shins. The tibialis anterior muscles on the front of the lower legs are visibly engaged, and the calf muscles are stretched, while the back remains straight and core engaged.

exercises.name: Prone T-Y-I Holds
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a bench with your chest at the edge and feet on the ground for stability. Your arms hang toward the floor with a slight bend in the elbows.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your torso remains face down on the bench with your chest at the edge. Your arms are straight out to the sides, roughly parallel to the floor, forming a 'T' shape with your body, elbows maintaining a slight bend and thumbs pointing towards the ceiling. Visible engagement occurs in the upper back and rear shoulder muscles, including the rhomboids and posterior deltoids.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
exercises.pose_description: Kneel with your right knee down and left foot forward in a half-kneeling position, facing the landmine. Hold the landmine bar at shoulder height with both hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the half-kneeling position with your right knee down and left foot forward, facing the landmine. Both arms are fully extended, holding the landmine bar at its highest point, overhead and slightly forward of the head. The shoulders and triceps are visibly contracted and elevated.

exercises.name: Shoulder Dislocate with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a resistance band with hands shoulder-width apart at hip height. Your arms are extended straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright holding a resistance band with hands shoulder-width apart behind your lower back, arms extended straight behind your torso with a slight bend in the elbows. The chest is open and shoulders are externally rotated and pulled back, visibly stretching the pectoral muscles and anterior deltoids.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Step your right foot forward into a lunge position.
exercises.end_pose_description: The right knee is bent at 90 degrees with the foot flat on the floor, and the left leg is fully extended straight back, toes on the ground. The torso is rotated open towards the right, with the right arm extended vertically towards the ceiling, palm facing forward. The left hand is planted on the floor inside the right foot. This posture visibly stretches the left hip flexors and inner right thigh, while engaging the right gluteals and obliques.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms are at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: The hips are elevated off the floor, aligning the torso and thighs into a straight line from the shoulders to the knees. Knees remain bent over the ankles, actively pressing outward against the resistance band. The gluteal muscles and hamstrings are visibly contracted, with the hip flexors stretched.

exercises.name: Banded Shoulder Dislocations
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with a wide grip in front of your thighs. Keep your arms straight.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the resistance band with a wide grip behind your glutes. Your arms are straight and fully extended, with the shoulders externally rotated. The chest and front of the shoulders are visibly stretched, while the posterior deltoids and rhomboids are engaged to maintain the position.

exercises.name: Banded Pallof Press
exercises.pose_description: Stand perpendicular to an anchor point with the band looped around a sturdy object at chest height. Hold the band with both hands at your chest with knees slightly bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the perpendicular stance to the anchor point, keeping knees slightly bent. Both hands are fully extended straight out from the chest, holding the band tautly away from the body. The core, including the obliques and rectus abdominis, is visibly braced to resist rotational force, with the shoulders and triceps also engaged.

exercises.name: Banded Woodchop
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at your left shoulder height. Your arms are slightly bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your feet are shoulder-width apart, with your torso and hips rotated to the right. Both hands hold the resistance band down and across your body, positioned outside your right knee, with your arms extended and slightly bent. The right obliques are taut, and the left side of your core and upper back show a controlled stretch.

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Bend forward at the waist with a slight knee bend.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hands are flat on the floor, directly beneath the shoulders. The body is in a straight line from the top of the head to the heels, with legs fully extended and feet hip-width apart. The core and shoulder muscles are actively engaged, and the hamstrings are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your core engaged and maintain an upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain your upright posture and engaged core. Your arms are now fully extended straight overhead, parallel to each other, with elbows straight and palms facing each other. The deltoids and upper trapezius are engaged, while the latissimus dorsi and pectorals are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Leg Swings Forward and Back
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Keep your torso upright and engage your core.
exercises.end_pose_description: The free leg is extended straight backward, with the foot elevated behind the body. Its glutes are visibly engaged, while the hip flexors are stretched. The torso remains upright, and the core engaged, with the supporting leg maintaining its slight knee bend.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended forward for balance, and chest upright. Keep your weight distributed evenly across both feet.
exercises.end_pose_description: The hips are low, with the thighs parallel to the floor and knees deeply bent, aligned over the feet. The chest remains upright, and arms are extended forward for balance. The quadriceps and glutes are visibly engaged, while the glutes and hamstrings are in a stretched position.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.pose_description: Stand tall with feet together and hands on hips or extended for balance. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: One leg is stepped forward, with the front knee bent at approximately a 90-degree angle, directly over the ankle, and the thigh parallel to the floor. The rear leg's knee hovers just above the ground, with the heel lifted and weight on the ball of the foot. The torso remains upright and stacked over the hips, with the core engaged and hands positioned for balance. The glutes and quadriceps of the front leg are visibly engaged, while the hip flexors of the rear leg are stretched.

exercises.name: Standing Marching in Place
exercises.pose_description: Stand tall with feet together, arms at your sides, and good posture maintained. Engage your core for stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: One knee is flexed to hip height, forming a 90-degree angle at both the hip and knee, with the thigh parallel to the floor. The supporting leg is straight, maintaining a tall posture and a strong, engaged core. Arms are bent at the elbows, with the arm opposite the raised leg positioned forward. The hip flexors are visibly engaged in the raised leg, while the glutes and quadriceps of the supporting leg are engaged for stability.

exercises.name: Standing Torso Rotations
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent, with hands crossed over your chest or behind your head. Maintain an upright posture with engaged core.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso is rotated to its maximum comfortable range to one side, with hips stable and forward-facing, and feet hip-width apart with knees slightly bent; hands remain crossed over your chest or behind your head. Maintain an upright posture with the core actively engaged; obliques on the side of rotation are visibly engaged, while the opposite side of the torso experiences a stretch.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch Forward Fold
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms at your sides. Maintain a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso is folded forward from the hips, with the chest positioned close to the thighs. The knees remain slightly bent, and the arms hang loosely towards the floor, possibly touching the shins or floor. A significant stretch is visible along the posterior thighs, targeting the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Low Lunge
exercises.pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other foot stepped forward, hands resting on the front thigh. Keep your torso upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: The front knee is bent deeply, with the hips pressed low and forward, creating a deep stretch in the hip flexors of the kneeling leg. The torso remains upright, with hands resting on the front thigh.

exercises.name: Shoulder Cross Body Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and bring one arm across your body at shoulder height. Keep your posture upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, maintaining an upright posture. The stretching arm extends horizontally across the body at shoulder height. The opposite hand secures the forearm or elbow of the stretching arm, holding it firmly against the chest, with a noticeable elongation of the posterior deltoid and upper back muscles.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down on the floor with your arms extended overhead and legs straight, forehead neutral on the ground. Your entire body is in contact with the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: The arms are straight and extended overhead, hovering above the floor, and the legs are straight and fully extended, also elevated from the ground. The chest is lifted with the forehead maintaining a neutral gaze downward, away from the floor. Only the pelvis and lower abdomen remain in contact with the ground, creating a visible arch in the back from the engaged erector spinae muscles, glutes, and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance Hold
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet together, arms at sides or extended forward for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with the heel of one foot directly in front of and touching the toes of the other foot, creating a narrow, straight line. Arms remain at sides or extended forward for balance, and the gaze is straight ahead with a neutral spine. The intrinsic foot muscles, ankle stabilizers (such as the peroneals and tibialis anterior), and core muscles are visibly engaged to maintain stability.

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand with Band Assistance
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a firm chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your hands at chest height. Lean slightly forward with a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand tall and upright with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and a neutral spine. The resistance band is held taut around your hands at chest height, with the quadriceps, glutes, and core muscles visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Bicep Curls
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and step on the center of a resistance band. Hold the band ends at your sides with palms facing forward and arms straight.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hold the band ends with palms facing forward, and elbows fully flexed. The forearms are elevated, with hands positioned close to the shoulders and the biceps visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Heel-to-Toe Walking
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with arms extended to the sides for balance or lightly touching a wall. Look ahead and maintain good posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is upright with arms extended to the sides for balance or lightly touching a wall. The gaze is forward, and posture is good. One foot is directly in front of the other, with the heel of the forward foot touching the toes of the rear foot. Ankle stabilizing muscles across both legs are visibly engaged, and the calf of the rear leg shows a slight stretch.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Chest Press
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and wrap a resistance band around your upper back, holding the ends at chest height with elbows bent. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, core engaged, and posture upright. Your arms are fully extended straight forward at shoulder height, holding the resistance band taut in front of your chest. The pectoralis major muscles are visibly contracted, alongside engagement of the anterior deltoids and triceps.

exercises.name: Modified Wall Push-ups
exercises.pose_description: Stand arm's length away from a wall with feet hip-width apart. Place both palms flat against the wall at shoulder height.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is positioned close to the wall, with the chest a few inches from the surface. The elbows are fully bent, pointing backward, and the forearms are perpendicular to the wall. The pectoralis major and triceps are visibly engaged, and the upper back muscles are stretched.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Activation
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably in a chair with feet flat on the ground and spine in neutral position. Relax all muscles and take a deep breath.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body remains comfortably seated with feet flat on the ground and spine in neutral position. The pelvic floor muscles are maximally contracted, positioned in an internally elevated state. All surrounding muscles, including the glutes, inner thighs, and superficial abdominals, are relaxed.

exercises.name: Gentle Neck Stretches
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and facing forward. Keep your eyes level and jaw unclenched.
exercises.end_pose_description: The head is tilted towards the right shoulder, with the right ear nearing the right shoulder. The left side of the neck, including the left trapezius and sternocleidomastoid muscles, appears elongated and stretched. Shoulders remain relaxed and facing forward, with eyes level and jaw unclenched.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Press
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: The dumbbells are held directly over the chest, positioned above the shoulders, with arms extended upwards and elbows slightly bent. The pectoralis major and triceps brachii are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing inward. Maintain good posture with a slight bend in your knees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, maintaining a slight bend in the knees and good posture. Both arms are extended straight out to the sides, forming a T-shape with the body, with the dumbbells held at shoulder height and palms facing the floor. The lateral deltoids and upper trapezius are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squats
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell resting across your upper back and shoulders. Your chest is upright and core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your hips are deeply flexed, positioned below your knees, with your thighs parallel to the ground or lower. Your chest remains upright, though your torso is angled forward, and your core is engaged. The glutes and quadriceps are visibly engaged, while the hamstrings are stretched.

exercises.name: Weighted Lunges
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your core is braced and shoulders are back.
exercises.end_pose_description: One leg is forward with the knee bent at a 90-degree angle, its thigh parallel to the ground, while the other leg is extended back with its knee hovering just above the floor and heel lifted. The torso is upright, core braced, and dumbbells are held at the sides. Both the glutes and quadriceps are visibly contracted, and the hip flexors of the rear leg are stretched.

exercises.name: Deadlifts
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell on the ground close to your shins. Your back is straight, chest up, and shoulders slightly in front of the bar.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand fully upright, holding the barbell at arm's length against your thighs. Your hips and knees are fully extended, with your back straight and chest up. The glutes, hamstrings, and erector spinae are visibly contracted, and your shoulders are pulled slightly back.

exercises.name: Weighted Step-ups
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a sturdy bench or step holding dumbbells at your sides. Your posture is upright with core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: You stand fully upright atop the bench, with one foot planted firmly and entirely on its surface, core engaged. The glutes and quadriceps of the lead leg are visibly contracted as the other leg is fully extended and suspended just beneath you, with dumbbells remaining at your sides.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in an athletic stance. Your arms are at your sides and core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is airborne with the feet off the ground. Your legs are fully extended, and arms are straight down at your sides. Glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Weighted Calf Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your core is engaged and posture is tall.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is balanced on the balls of the feet and toes with heels maximally lifted off the ground. Dumbbells are held at the sides, and the core remains engaged with a tall, straight posture. The calf muscles are visibly contracted and bulging.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges with Twist
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a weight plate or dumbbell at chest height with both hands. Your feet are hip-width apart and core is braced.
exercises.end_pose_description: One leg is forward in a deep lunge position, with the front thigh parallel to the floor and the back knee bent just above the ground. The torso is rotated towards the front leg, as both hands hold the weight plate or dumbbell at chest height. The glutes and quadriceps are engaged, the back hip flexor is stretched, and the obliques are visibly contracting.

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform with feet hip-width apart. Your arms are ready to swing and core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: You are now standing on top of the box with feet hip-width apart. Your knees are deeply bent and hips are flexed, placing you in a quarter-squat position, with visible engagement in the quadriceps and glutes. Arms are extended forward for balance, and your core remains engaged to stabilize your torso.

exercises.name: Banded Squats
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band looped under both feet and held at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The hips are deeply lowered, with the thighs parallel to the ground or slightly below, and knees sharply bent, tracking over the feet. The chest remains upright and the core is engaged, with the resistance band tautly stretched while still held at shoulder height. The quadriceps and gluteal muscles are visibly contracted, and the hamstrings are under significant stretch.

exercises.name: Banded Chest Press
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with the resistance band wrapped around your mid-back, holding both ends at chest level with elbows bent. Keep your shoulders relaxed and back straight.
exercises.end_pose_description: Remain seated upright with the resistance band stretched tautly in front of you, arms fully extended straight forward at chest level while holding the band ends. Your shoulders remain relaxed, back straight, and chest muscles are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Banded Rows
exercises.pose_description: Sit with legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet or mid-shin, holding both ends with arms extended. Keep your back straight and shoulders back.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the seated position with legs extended, the resistance band still looped around the feet or mid-shin. Your elbows are bent, and hands are held close to the torso, with the back remaining straight and shoulder blades retracted, visibly engaging the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and biceps.

exercises.name: Banded Bicep Curls
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, standing on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Hold both ends of the band at your sides with palms facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: The feet remain hip-width apart, standing on the resistance band. Both hands, holding the band ends, are positioned near the shoulders with palms facing forward and elbows fully bent. The biceps and forearms are visibly engaged and contracted.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, stepping on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Hold both ends at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, still stepping on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Both arms are extended laterally to shoulder height, forming a T-shape with the body. The hands grip the band ends with palms facing downward, and the lateral deltoids are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridges
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped just above your knees. Place your arms at your sides with palms down.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body forms a straight line from the shoulders through the hips to the knees, with hips fully extended and elevated off the floor. Your glutes and hamstrings are visibly contracted, and your hip flexors are stretched. Your upper back and shoulders remain on the floor, with arms at your sides and palms down, while your feet stay flat on the floor, hip-width apart.

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring Curls
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around one foot, holding the other end of the band or a stable surface for balance. Keep your standing leg straight and core tight.
exercises.end_pose_description: The active leg is bent at the knee, with the heel pulled up towards the glutes and the resistance band taut, while the standing leg remains straight and core is tight. The hamstrings of the active leg are visibly contracted, and its quadriceps are stretched.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Kickbacks
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or holding onto a stable surface with a resistance band looped around one leg just above the knee. Keep your torso still and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The banded leg is extended directly backward, with the foot elevated slightly off the floor. The standing leg is straight, supporting the still, upright torso and engaged core. The gluteal muscles of the extended leg are contracted, and the hip flexors of the standing leg are stretched.

exercises.name: Banded Shoulder External Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, holding one end of a resistance band that is anchored at elbow height. Keep your elbow firmly against your rib cage.
exercises.end_pose_description: You remain seated upright with your elbow still bent to 90 degrees and firmly pressed against your rib cage. Your forearm has rotated outward, pulling the resistance band taut, with your hand now positioned further away from your torso. The infraspinatus and teres minor muscles in your shoulder are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Marches
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs above the knees, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture, core engaged, with one foot planted firmly on the ground, supporting the body. The opposite leg is lifted, with the thigh parallel to the floor and the knee bent to a 90-degree angle, foot off the ground. The resistance band is stretched taut above the knees, indicating visible engagement of the hip flexors and quadriceps of the lifted leg, and the gluteus medius of the standing leg for stabilization.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with your shoulder abducted 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing toward the ceiling. Keep your shoulder blade flat against the surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your shoulder remains abducted 90 degrees and your elbow bent to 90 degrees. The forearm is rotated backward until the back of your hand rests on the surface above your head. The external rotators of the shoulder are engaged, and the internal rotators along the front of the shoulder and chest are stretched.

exercises.name: Standing Scapular Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides with palms facing forward. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed and chest open.
exercises.end_pose_description: The feet remain shoulder-width apart, with arms at your sides and palms facing forward. The shoulders are visibly retracted and slightly depressed, with the shoulder blades maximally squeezed together toward the spine. The middle trapezius and rhomboids are visibly contracted, and the chest remains open.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder Horizontal Abduction
exercises.pose_description: Lying face down on a bench with the head resting on the surface and neck neutral. One arm is held horizontally out to the side, fully extended and parallel to the floor at 90 degrees of horizontal abduction (forming a T-shape with the torso when viewed from above). The arm is actively raised to shoulder level, NOT hanging down. The thumb points up, palm faces forward. The other arm rests alongside the body.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lying face down on a bench with the head resting on the surface and neck neutral. One arm is held horizontally out to the side, fully extended, and maximally elevated towards the ceiling, maintaining 90 degrees of horizontal abduction (a T-shape with the torso when viewed from above). The arm is significantly higher than the shoulder level, with the thumb pointing up and palm facing forward. The posterior deltoid, infraspinatus, and upper back muscles are visibly engaged, while the other arm rests alongside the body.

exercises.name: Standing Chest Doorway Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand in a doorway with one arm raised and forearm against the door frame, elbow at 90 degrees. Step forward slightly with the opposite leg.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso is leaned forward through the doorway, with the chest extended past the door frame and the front of the shoulder pulled back. The arm is raised with its forearm against the door frame, elbow at 90 degrees, and the pectoral muscles and anterior deltoid are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest level with both hands. Your spine is neutral and shoulders are back.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your hips are deeply descended, with thighs parallel to the floor or lower, and knees sharply bent over the toes while feet remain flat. The dumbbell is held vertically at chest level, with a neutral spine, slightly forward-inclined torso, and shoulders back, as the quadriceps, glutes, and core are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand with a slight knee bend. Your standing leg is engaged and your core is tight.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your torso is hinged forward from the hips, almost parallel to the floor, with a straight back and a neutral head. The dumbbell hangs straight down close to the shin of your standing leg, which maintains its slight knee bend, while your non-standing leg is extended straight back, level with your torso. The hamstring and glute of the standing leg are fully stretched and engaged, and your core is tightly braced to maintain this aligned position.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side with a neutral spine. Your shoulders are level and your core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright with a neutral spine, holding the dumbbell in one hand at your side. Your shoulders are level, actively resisting the lateral pull of the weight. The obliques on the side opposite the dumbbell are strongly contracted, and the gluteus medius on the unweighted side is actively engaged, maintaining a stable and level pelvis.

exercises.name: Step-Up with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a bench or elevated platform holding dumbbells at your sides with your core engaged. Your posture is upright and your feet are hip-width apart.
exercises.end_pose_description: You are standing fully upright on the elevated platform with your lead leg extended straight, bearing your full body weight, core engaged, and posture upright. The opposite leg is lifted, with its knee bent and foot hovering above the platform. The glutes, quadriceps, and hamstrings of the extended leg are visibly contracted, and dumbbells remain at your sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the ground, holding dumbbells at chest height with elbows at 90 degrees. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Dumbbells are held directly above the chest with arms fully extended, perpendicular to the floor. Pectorals and triceps are maximally contracted, while your spine remains neutral, core engaged, and glutes actively contracted to stabilize the hips.

exercises.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides, palms facing up. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body remains supine with legs extended and arms at its sides, palms facing up, appearing heavy and deeply relaxed against the surface. Neck remains neutral, and shoulders are profoundly settled away from the ears. The entire body's musculature, including facial muscles, is completely softened and free of all tension.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with arms extended out to the sides in a T position. Bend your right knee and bring it toward your chest.
exercises.end_pose_description: The right knee is extended across the body, now resting on the floor to the left side, with the left leg remaining straight and flat. The torso and lower back are visibly twisted, while the right arm and shoulder stay firmly pressed into the floor. This position shows a deep stretch through the obliques and lower back, with the right glute also engaged.

exercises.name: Deep Breathing with Body Scan
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back on a comfortable surface with legs extended and arms slightly away from your body, palms facing up. Close your eyes and allow your shoulders to relax down and away from your ears.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body remains flat on its back with legs extended, arms slightly away from the body, palms facing up, and eyes closed, shoulders relaxed down and away from the ears. At the peak of a deep inhalation, the torso is visibly expanded, with the rib cage elevated and broadened, and the abdomen gently distended. This expansion signifies full engagement of the diaphragm and a stretch throughout the intercostal muscles.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band loosely around your torso at chest level with both hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso is expanded from a deep, full inhalation, stretching the resistance band tightly around the chest and ribs. The diaphragm and intercostal muscles are engaged, with the lower ribs and abdomen visibly expanded.

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls with Band Resistance
exercises.pose_description: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at shoulder height with both hands in front of you. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body maintains a tall stance with feet shoulder-width apart and core engaged. The shoulders are actively pulled back and down, with the shoulder blades squeezed together and depressed. The resistance band is held tautly at shoulder height, pulled horizontally backward. The rhomboids, middle, and lower trapezius are visibly contracted, while the pectoralis muscles are stretched.

exercises.name: Assisted Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your back and holding both ends in your hands. Your spine should be in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your spine is significantly arched downward, creating a deep concave curve in your lower back. Your head is tilted upwards, with your gaze directed towards the ceiling. The resistance band remains looped around your back, gently assisting this spinal extension, as your abdominal muscles are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Standing Torso Rotation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands extended in front of you. Engage your core and keep your hips still.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hips still, and your torso rotated fully to one side. Your shoulders are perpendicular to your hips, and both hands remain extended, holding the resistance band at chest height out to your side. Your obliques on the side of rotation are visibly engaged, while the obliques on the opposite side are elongated.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch with Band Assist
exercises.pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge position, holding a resistance band around your back knee. Keep your torso upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is in a deep lunge, with the hips positioned fully forward and down, while the torso remains upright and the pelvis posteriorly tilted. The resistance band, held taut around the back knee, assists in maintaining maximal hip extension, visibly stretching the hip flexors of the kneeling leg.

exercises.name: Gentle Spinal Twist
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a light resistance band across your chest. Arms are extended out to the sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: The individual is on their back with both knees stacked and resting on the floor to one side, feet also stacked. The upper back and shoulders remain flat on the floor, arms extended out to the sides, holding the resistance band taut across the chest. The head faces the direction opposite the knees, and the obliques and outer hip on the side opposite the knees are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Chest Opening
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat, holding a resistance band behind your back at elbow height with both arms bent. Your chest is slightly rounded forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your arms are straightened and extended further back, pulling the resistance band taut behind you. Your chest is fully opened and lifted, with the pectoral muscles visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart for Posture
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height holding a resistance band with both hands. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height, holding the resistance band stretched taut across your chest with a slight bend in your elbows. The shoulder blades are visibly squeezed together, engaging the rhomboids and middle trapezius, while the pectorals are stretched.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Rolls
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your back straight and look forward with a neutral head position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed, your back straight. Your head is fully lowered forward, with your chin pressed gently against your chest. The muscles along the entire back of your neck, including the upper trapezius, are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Supine Knee to Chest Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back on a padded surface with both legs extended and arms at your sides. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lie on your back with your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor. One leg is extended flat on the surface. The opposite hip is fully flexed, and the knee is deeply bent, bringing the thigh close to the chest. Both hands are clasped around the shin or just below the bent knee, holding the leg firmly in this position. The gluteal muscles, hamstrings, and lower back on the side of the bent leg are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Seated Marching in Place
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms relaxed at your sides. Maintain good posture with your back against the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso remains upright with your back against the chair and arms relaxed at your sides. One leg is lifted, with the knee bent and the thigh raised away from the chair seat, while the opposite foot stays flat on the floor. The foot of the lifted leg is suspended in the air. Hip flexors and abdominal muscles are visibly engaged, maintaining the lifted position and core stability.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Tilts
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. Keep arms at your sides with palms down on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: The lower back is pressed flat against the floor, eliminating its natural arch. The pelvis is posteriorly tilted, with the tailbone slightly lifted from the floor. The abdominal muscles are engaged and visibly contracted, while the lower back muscles are stretched.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Rolls
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat and arms relaxed at your sides. Keep your back straight and look straight ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: The shoulders are elevated high towards the ears and pulled back as far as comfortable. The back remains straight and the head faces forward. The upper trapezius and rhomboids are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Quadruped Arm and Leg Lifts
exercises.pose_description: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core gently engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: One arm is extended straight forward, palm facing down, with the hand at shoulder height, while the opposite leg is extended straight back, foot flexed, with the heel at hip height. The extended arm and leg are parallel to the floor, maintaining a neutral spine and level hips, with visible engagement of the erector spinae, glutes, hamstrings, and deltoids.

exercises.name: Seated Figure Four Hip Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and good posture. Keep your core gently engaged and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the upright seated posture, core gently engaged, and shoulders relaxed. One ankle rests across the opposite thigh, just above the knee, with the crossed leg's knee pointing outwards. The torso leans gently forward, creating a visible stretch in the gluteal muscles and outer hip of the crossed leg.

exercises.name: Standing Wall Supported Marching
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall with feet about hip-width apart, hands lightly touching the wall for balance. Maintain upright posture with core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: One leg is lifted with the knee bent, bringing the thigh parallel to the floor and the shin perpendicular to the thigh. The standing leg remains straight with its foot flat on the ground. Upright posture is maintained with the core engaged, and hands lightly touch the wall. The hip flexors of the lifted leg are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Supine Glute Bridges
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your hips are fully elevated off the floor, creating a straight line from your shoulders through your hips to your knees. Your glutes and hamstrings are visibly contracted, and your hip flexors are stretched. Your head, shoulders, and feet remain firmly on the floor, with your arms at your sides.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Raise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold dumbbells at your sides with arms hanging naturally.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Dumbbells are held at shoulder height, with arms extended laterally out from the torso. The shoulders, particularly the deltoids, are visibly engaged, and a slight bend is present in the elbows.

exercises.name: Neck and Shoulder Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your back straight and shoulders relaxed. Keep your chin level and looking forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your head is tilted to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder. Your left shoulder remains relaxed and gently depressed, visibly lengthening the muscles along the left side of your neck, including the upper trapezius and sternocleidomastoid.

exercises.name: Standing Bicep Curl
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. The dumbbells are elevated to shoulder height, with elbows fully bent and palms still facing forward, positioned close to the shoulders. The biceps brachii are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Step
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding light dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body maintains an upright posture, shifted over one leg which is extended laterally with its foot firmly on the ground. The knee of the stepping leg is slightly bent, bearing the majority of the body weight. The other leg is extended straight to the side, with its heel slightly lifted and only the toe lightly touching the ground for balance. Dumbbells are held at the sides. The core is engaged, the gluteus medius and quadriceps of the stepping leg are engaged, and the adductors of the straight leg are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Gentle Hand and Wrist Circles
exercises.pose_description: Stand with arms extended in front of you at shoulder height with palms facing down. Keep your elbows straight but not locked.
exercises.end_pose_description: The arms remain extended in front at shoulder height, with elbows straight but not locked. The wrists are fully flexed, with the fingertips pointing directly towards the floor and the palms facing towards the body. The flexor muscles on the anterior aspect of the forearm are engaged, while the wrist extensors on the posterior aspect are stretched.

exercises.name: Shoulder Pendulum Swings
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and let your affected arm hang naturally at your side. Lean slightly forward at the hips for support.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the slight forward hip lean and shoulder-width foot stance. The affected arm is positioned forward in front of the body, hanging freely, with the hand at approximately waist height. The posterior shoulder joint capsule and surrounding rotator cuff muscles are in a gently stretched state.

exercises.name: Knee Extension and Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a firm chair with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Keep your affected knee bent at approximately 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit in a firm chair with your back against the backrest. Your affected knee is fully straightened, with the leg extended forward and parallel to the floor, and the quadriceps muscles on the front of your thigh are visibly tensed.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Lying
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with your body in a straight line and hips stacked. Keep your head resting on your lower arm for comfort.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body remains in a straight line with hips stacked, and the head rests on the lower arm. The top leg is straight and elevated away from the bottom leg, with the gluteus medius and minimus visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Elbow Flexion with Light Resistance
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair and hold a light dumbbell (1-3 lbs) in your affected hand with your arm at your side and palm facing forward. Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair and hold a light dumbbell (1-3 lbs) in your affected hand, with your upper arm remaining at your side and palm facing forward. Your affected forearm is fully raised with your elbow maximally bent, bringing the dumbbell close to your shoulder, with your bicep visibly contracted and your tricep stretched.

exercises.name: Ankle Alphabet Tracing
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a chair and extend one leg out in front of you or rest your foot on another chair. Keep your thigh supported and relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: The extended leg remains supported and relaxed. The ankle is positioned at its maximum range of motion, with the foot strongly plantarflexed and simultaneously everted, so the sole faces slightly outward and the toes point downwards. The lateral calf muscles (peroneals) and soleus are visibly engaged, while the muscles along the front and inner part of the shin are elongated.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Ups Modified
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall at arm's length away with feet shoulder-width apart and palms placed flat against the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body straight from head to heels.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is angled towards the wall, with the chest positioned close to its surface. Elbows are bent, pointing directly behind the body, while the overall straight line from head to heels is maintained. The pectoralis major, triceps brachii, and anterior deltoids appear visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Finger Dexterity Exercises with Putty
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a comfortable position and hold soft therapy putty in your hand with fingers relaxed and extended. The putty should be soft enough to manipulate without pain.
exercises.end_pose_description: The individual sits in a comfortable position, with fingers tightly curled into a fist, deeply compressing the therapy putty within the palm. The flexor muscles of the forearm and the intrinsic muscles of the hand are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Banded Bicep Curl
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet, holding one end in each hand with arms at your sides. Keep your elbows tucked close to your torso.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso remains upright with feet hip-width apart, the resistance band still anchored under both feet and held in each hand, while forearms are fully flexed, bringing hands close to the shoulders with palms facing inwards, and elbows tucked close to the torso. The biceps are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your hips are fully raised, aligning your torso and thighs into a straight line from shoulders to knees. Your knees stay bent, pressed outwards against the resistance band just above them, with feet remaining flat on the floor. Your arms are still at your sides with palms down. Your glutes are strongly contracted, hamstrings are engaged, and inner thighs are visibly working.

exercises.name: Banded Row
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and loop the resistance band around a stationary object at chest height or hold it in both hands. Extend your arms forward with elbows slightly bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your hands are positioned back towards your torso, with elbows sharply bent and tucked close to your body. Your shoulder blades are retracted, revealing visible contraction in the back muscles (latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, trapezius) and biceps.

exercises.name: Banded Overhead Press
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet. Hold one end in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the resistance band still under both feet. Both arms are fully extended straight overhead, with hands positioned directly above the shoulders and palms facing forward. The deltoids, triceps, and upper trapezius are visibly engaged, with the latissimus dorsi muscles stretched.

exercises.name: Banded Squat
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet, holding one end in each hand at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The hips are positioned low, with the thighs parallel to the ground and the knees fully bent, tracking directly over the feet. The chest remains upright, and the core is tightly engaged. The glutes and quadriceps are heavily engaged, and the hamstrings are stretched.

exercises.name: Marching in Place
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together, arms at your sides, and maintain good posture. Engage your core and prepare to lift your knees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture with one foot flat on the ground. The opposite knee is highly flexed, with the thigh parallel to the floor and the shin vertical; the foot is dorsiflexed. The arm opposite the flexed knee is bent 90 degrees at the elbow and held forward at shoulder height, while the other arm is bent and positioned backward. The core remains engaged, and the hip flexors and quadriceps of the elevated leg are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and loop a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees. Place your hands on your hips or hold onto a wall for balance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture, balancing on one planted leg. The opposite leg is extended straight out to the side, creating maximal tension in the resistance band just above the knees. The gluteus medius and minimus of the extended leg are visibly contracted, and the adductors of the standing leg are stretched. Hands remain on the hips or grasping the wall for stability.

exercises.name: Brisk Walking
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture with shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: One leg is extended forward with the foot planted and knee slightly bent, while the opposite leg is extended backward with the heel lifted and toes pushing off. The arm opposite the forward leg is swung forward, with the elbow bent and hand at chest height, while the other arm is swung backward with the elbow bent. The torso maintains an upright posture with an engaged core and relaxed shoulders. The glutes and calves of the rear leg are visibly engaged, and the hip flexors of that leg are stretched.

exercises.name: Standing Arm Circles
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your chest open and core engaged throughout the movement.
exercises.end_pose_description: The individual maintains a standing posture with feet shoulder-width apart, chest open, and core engaged. The arms are extended straight overhead, aligned with the ears, with palms facing inward. This final position emphasizes visible engagement of the deltoids and trapezius, alongside a stretch through the latissimus dorsi and pectorals.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Twist
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and cross your arms over your chest. Maintain good posture with your spine neutral.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the seated position with feet flat on the floor and arms crossed over the chest. The upper body, including the head and shoulders, is rotated maximally to one side while the hips remain forward, stretching the obliques and back muscles on the opposite side and engaging those on the rotating side.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Sets
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding onto a sturdy surface for balance with feet hip-width apart. Keep one leg straight and slightly engaged while the other remains relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright holding onto a sturdy surface for balance with feet hip-width apart. The working leg is fully extended and straight, with the quadriceps muscle visibly tight and engaged on the front of the thigh, pulling the kneecap upwards. The knee joint is locked into its most straightened position, while the other leg remains relaxed.

exercises.name: Standing Balance Stance
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms extended in front of you or holding onto a stable surface. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand firmly on one leg, with the other leg lifted and its foot suspended a few inches from the ground. Your hips are level and your torso remains erect, with your core deeply engaged for stability and arms extended forward for counter-balance. The glutes, quadriceps, and calf muscles of the standing leg are visibly contracted, alongside the engaged hip flexors of the lifted leg.

exercises.name: Pursed-Lip Breathing with Arm Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Take a slow breath in through your nose for a count of 2.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart. Your arms are fully extended overhead, palms facing each other, and your lips are gently pursed as you slowly exhale. The deltoids and upper trapezius are visibly engaged, and the chest muscles are stretched.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, light dumbbells held directly overhead. Your arms are fully extended with straight but not locked elbows, and wrists aligned directly over shoulders. Your core remains engaged and spine neutral, with visible engagement in the deltoids and triceps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls with Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in each hand with arms hanging at your sides and palms facing forward. Maintain neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is upright with feet hip-width apart and a neutral spine. Dumbbells are near the shoulders, with elbows fully flexed and palms facing upwards. The biceps brachii are visibly contracted and the triceps are stretched.

exercises.name: Walking with Metronome Pacing
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright in an open space, ready to walk at a comfortable pace. Focus on maintaining an even breathing rhythm synchronized with your steps.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body maintains an upright posture, slightly leaning forward, with one arm forward and the opposite arm positioned to the rear. One leg is extended forward with its foot on the ground, while the other leg is extended backward with only the toes in contact. The quadriceps of the front leg are engaged, and the glutes and calves of the rear leg are visibly active, with its hip flexors stretched.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Stretch with Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor, hands clasped gently behind your head. Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows out to the sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: The seated position is maintained with feet flat and hands clasped behind your head. Your upper back is gently arched, with the chest expanded forward and elbows drawn further back behind the body, visibly stretching the chest muscles.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Rows
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, slightly bend knees, and hinge at hips about 45 degrees. Hold dumbbells with straight arms hanging below shoulders.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain feet shoulder-width apart, slightly bent knees, and the 45-degree hip hinge. Dumbbells are pulled upwards to the sides of the torso, with elbows bent and pointing towards the ceiling. The upper back and latissimus dorsi muscles are visibly contracted, along with the biceps.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing in Supine
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place one hand on your chest and one on your abdomen.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, with the hand on your abdomen visibly elevated. Your abdomen is fully distended outwards, indicating a relaxed abdominal wall and a contracted diaphragm.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in hands at your sides with palms facing inward. Engage core and maintain neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body remains upright with feet hip-width apart, core engaged, and spine neutral. The arms are extended laterally, parallel to the floor, with a slight bend at the elbows. Dumbbells are at shoulder height, and palms face the floor, with the deltoid muscles visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Seated Marching with Arm Movements
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor and dumbbells at your sides. Maintain good posture with shoulders back.
exercises.end_pose_description: One knee is lifted high towards the chest, with the foot elevated off the floor. The opposite arm is bent at the elbow and positioned forward, while the other arm is bent at the elbow and positioned backward. The torso maintains its upright posture, with visible engagement in the hip flexors and quadriceps of the lifted leg, and the deltoids, biceps, and triceps of the respective arms.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Sets with Breathing Focus
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended, a small rolled towel under one knee. Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Still lying on your back, the leg with the towel under the knee is fully straightened. The quadriceps muscle on this leg is visibly contracted as the back of the knee presses firmly into the towel, with the heel remaining on the floor. The other leg stays relaxed on the floor.

exercises.name: Single Leg Stand
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides or extended for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: One foot is lifted clear of the floor, with the knee slightly bent and the foot suspended freely. The entire body weight rests on the opposite standing leg, with the ankle stabilizers and calf muscles (gastrocnemius, soleus) visibly taut to maintain balance, and the gluteus medius engaged to keep the hips level. The torso remains upright with a neutral spine, and the arms are extended to the sides for balance while the gaze holds straight ahead.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or extended outward for balance. Keep your gaze fixed on a point at eye level.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture with the heel of one foot placed directly in front of and touching the toes of the other foot, your arms at your sides or extended outward for balance. Your gaze remains fixed at eye level, while the muscles of the ankles and feet, particularly the tibialis anterior and calf muscles, show subtle engagement to maintain stability.

exercises.name: Sit to Stand
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor positioned hip-width apart. Lean your torso slightly forward with hands either crossed on your chest or on the chair seat.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand fully upright with your torso erect and your knees extended. Your feet remain flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart, with hands either still crossed on your chest or resting at your sides. The glutes and quadriceps are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Heel Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a sturdy counter or wall for light balance support. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture, keeping your spine neutral and core engaged. Your hands remain lightly on the counter for balance. Your heels are raised fully off the ground, with your entire body weight supported on the balls of your feet and toes, and your calf muscles visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Tandem Walking
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright next to a wall or sturdy railing for light support. Position your feet in a heel-to-toe alignment as if walking a narrow line.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body remains upright, with light support maintained at the wall or railing. The foot that was previously behind is now forward, its heel making contact with the toes of the other foot, establishing a new heel-to-toe alignment. The stabilizing muscles of the ankles and feet are visibly engaged to maintain this balanced posture.

exercises.name: Clock Reach
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg in the center of an imaginary clock face, lightly touching a wall or railing for balance. Keep your standing leg slightly bent and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The standing leg remains slightly bent, its sole flat on the ground with the calf and glute muscles visibly engaged for stability. The other leg is fully extended forward, with its heel resting lightly on the imaginary 12 o'clock position, stretching the hamstring of that leg. The torso is slightly hinged at the hips, maintaining a straight spine with core muscles engaged, and the arms are extended forward for counter-balance.

exercises.name: Banded Quadriceps Sets
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your back supported and a small rolled towel placed under one knee. A resistance band is looped around that thigh for added resistance.
exercises.end_pose_description: The upright seated position is maintained with the back supported. The knee on the towel-supported leg is pressed down firmly, causing that heel to lift just above the floor, with the quadriceps visibly flexed and the resistance band taut around the thigh.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Hip Extension
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or rail with hands lightly resting on it for balance and a resistance band looped around both feet. Keep your standing leg straight and core tight.
exercises.end_pose_description: The upright posture is maintained, with the standing leg straight and core tight, and hands lightly resting on the wall or rail for balance. The other leg is extended straight backward, creating peak tension against the resistance band. The gluteal muscles of the extended leg are visibly engaged, while the hip flexors are stretched.

exercises.name: Gentle Knee Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back supported against the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright seated posture with your back supported against the chair. One leg is positioned with the heel lifted from the floor and pulled back beneath the chair, its knee acutely bent, while the hamstrings are contracted and the quadriceps are stretched.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Circles
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back on a firm surface with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor. Keep the other leg extended or slightly bent for comfort.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your back remains on the firm surface, and the opposite knee stays bent with its foot flat on the floor. The working leg is lifted off the floor with a straight knee, elevated approximately 6-12 inches and held slightly out to the side away from the body's midline. This position visibly engages the hip flexors, quadriceps, and outer hip abductor muscles, while the inner thigh adductors are gently lengthened.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Abduction
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Maintain an upright posture with good back support.
exercises.end_pose_description: The individual remains seated upright with good back support. Both knees are positioned outwards, as far apart as comfortably possible, with feet flat on the floor and significantly wider than hip-width apart. The gluteus medius and minimus muscles are visibly engaged on the outer hips, while the inner thigh adductor muscles appear stretched.

exercises.name: Seated Ankle Circles
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair and lift one foot slightly off the ground, keeping the knee bent at a comfortable angle. Rest your hands on your lap for balance.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body remains seated upright in the chair, with hands resting on the lap for balance. The working foot is extended downwards, with the toes reaching strongly towards the floor and the sole rotated slightly outwards, away from the body's midline. This position fully engages the calf muscles, particularly the gastrocnemius and soleus, and visibly stretches the tibialis anterior and other muscles along the front of the lower leg.

exercises.name: Seated Bicep Curls
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, arms at sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Keep elbows stationary against your torso throughout the movement.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, with elbows stationary against your torso and forearms fully flexed upwards. Dumbbells are held close to the shoulders with palms facing the chest, and the biceps brachii are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extensions
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your back against the chair and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright seated position with your back against the chair and core engaged. Both legs are extended straight out in front of you, with the knees fully straightened. Your feet are parallel to the floor, and the quadriceps muscles on the front of your thighs are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Press
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at chest level with elbows bent and palms facing forward. Keep your back against the chair for support.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells extended forward at chest level with arms almost straight and palms facing forward. Your back remains against the chair for support. The chest (pectoral) and triceps muscles are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Seated Tricep Extensions
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms bent at 90 degrees with the weight behind your head. Keep your elbows pointing forward and core tight.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair holding a dumbbell with both hands directly overhead, arms fully extended straight up towards the ceiling. Your elbows remain pointing forward and your core is tight. The triceps are visibly engaged and contracted.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, legs extended in front of you or feet on the ground. Keep your spine straight and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso is folded deeply forward, with the chest resting on or near the thighs and the head dropped towards the knees. The spine is rounded and elongated, while the shoulders remain relaxed. Hands are reaching towards the feet, shins, or the floor beside the feet. The hamstrings, glutes, and the entire back, particularly the lumbar and thoracic regions, are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance Balance
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides or extended for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: One foot is positioned directly in front of the other, with the heel of the front foot touching the toes of the back foot. Arms are at sides or extended for balance, the spine is neutral, and the gaze is straight ahead, with core, glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calf muscles engaged for stability.

exercises.name: Single Leg Stance
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides or ready to use nearby support. Engage your core and maintain upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your weight is fully supported by one leg, with the opposing foot suspended just off the floor. The standing leg's glutes, quadriceps, and calf muscles are visibly taut, maintaining a stable and upright torso. Arms are positioned slightly away from the body, offering counter-balance.

exercises.name: Marching in Place with High Knees
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees ready to swing. Maintain an engaged core and neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: One foot is firmly planted on the ground, with the opposing knee elevated to hip height; the thigh is parallel to the floor and the shin perpendicular. The arm on the side of the raised knee is swung back, and the opposite arm is swung forward, both bent at 90 degrees. The hip flexors and core are visibly engaged, alongside the quadriceps and glutes of the supporting leg, maintaining a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Seated Trunk Rotations
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a bench with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso is rotated to one side, with the shoulders and head facing that direction, while the hips remain stable and forward. The obliques on the side of rotation are visibly contracted, and the spinal muscles on the opposite side are stretched.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Marches with Wall Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall with hands lightly on it for balance, feet hip-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body maintains its position facing the wall with hands lightly on it, spine neutral and core engaged. One foot is planted on the floor with the standing leg's glute and quadriceps engaged. The opposite leg is lifted, with the hip flexed to 90 degrees and the knee bent, so the thigh is parallel to the floor, showcasing engaged hip flexors.

exercises.name: Gait Training with Walking Pattern Focus
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with good posture, feet together, ready to walk forward. Focus on maintaining balance and awareness of body position.
exercises.end_pose_description: One leg is extended forward, with its foot flat on the ground, bearing most of the body's weight. The other leg trails behind, with its heel lifted and the foot resting on its toes. The body remains upright with good posture, core muscles engaged, and arms are positioned in a reciprocal swing. The glutes and quadriceps of the forward leg are visibly engaged for stability, while the calf muscles of the trailing leg are contracted.

exercises.name: Sit to Stand Practice
exercises.pose_description: Sit on a sturdy chair or bench with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back against the backrest with hands on armrests if available.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright with your hips and knees fully extended, and your spine straight and erect. Your feet remain flat on the floor, hip-width apart, supporting your full body weight. Quadriceps, glutes, and core muscles are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Wrist Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your affected forearm resting on a table, palm facing downward. Hold a looped resistance band around your hand with light to moderate tension.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the seated position with the affected forearm resting on the table, palm facing downward. The hand is angled upwards at the wrist, with the back of the hand lifted significantly higher than the forearm, and the wrist extensors on the top of the forearm visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Finger Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected hand relaxed in front of you, fingers extended. Loop a resistance band around your fingers with light tension.
exercises.end_pose_description: The affected hand remains comfortably in front, with the fingers now fully curled inwards towards the palm. The resistance band is tautly stretched around the flexed fingers, and the flexor muscles along the palm and underside of the forearm are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Abduction
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored under your feet. Your affected arm hangs at your side with the band in your hand.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the stretched resistance band anchored under your feet. The affected arm is positioned straight out to the side, parallel to the floor, with the hand at shoulder height, and the deltoid muscles are engaged.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Elbow Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with your affected arm at your side, holding one end of a resistance band that is anchored under your feet. Your elbow should be slightly bent with palm facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright with your affected arm's forearm fully bent towards your shoulder. Your hand, still holding the resistance band, is near your shoulder, with your palm facing forward. The biceps brachii on the front of your upper arm are maximally contracted, and the triceps on the back are stretched.

exercises.name: Shoulder Flexor Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright and hold a resistance band with both hands, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height. Keep your feet shoulder-width apart for stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand upright, with your arms fully extended overhead and slightly behind the plane of your body, holding the resistance band taut with both hands. Your feet remain shoulder-width apart for stability. The anterior deltoid and pectoralis major muscles are visibly stretched across the front of the chest and shoulder.

exercises.name: Heel-Toe Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart near a wall or counter for light support. Keep your posture upright and hands available to lightly touch the support if needed.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is tall and stable, balanced on the balls of the feet with the heels maximally elevated above the floor. The calves are visibly contracted and engaged, supporting the full body weight. Hands remain available for light support if needed.

exercises.name: Tandem Standing
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet together near a wall or sturdy support that you can hold if needed. Keep your posture upright and eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: One foot is placed directly in front of the other, with the heel of the front foot touching the toes of the back foot.
