Your posture remains upright, eyes focused on a fixed point ahead, with hands free and ready to reach for support if needed. Core muscles are actively engaged to maintain the body's stability, alongside continuous engagement from the leg, foot, and ankle muscles.

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is in a deep squat with hips below the knees, maintaining a straight back and upright chest, core engaged. The dumbbell is held vertically at chest height, with the glutes and quadriceps engaged, and the hamstrings and adductors deeply stretched.

exercises.name: Seated Rows
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at sides with arms extended forward. Maintain neutral spine alignment.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture and neutral spine with feet flat on the floor. The dumbbells are held close to the sides of the torso, with elbows bent and pointing directly backward. Shoulders are retracted, and shoulder blades are squeezed together, visibly engaging the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and trapezius.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abductions
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Hold dumbbells at sides with arms straight.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body maintains an upright posture, balancing firmly on one straight leg. The opposite leg is extended straight out to the side, with the foot elevated off the ground and away from the body's midline. Dumbbells are held at the sides with arms straight, while the gluteus medius and minimus of the extended leg are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Stretches
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright and use a wall or chair for balance with one hand. Stand on one leg with good posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: The free hand holds the ankle of the lifted leg, with the heel positioned close to the buttocks. The knee of the lifted leg points directly downwards, adjacent to the standing leg. The quadriceps of the lifted leg are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side with the bottom leg bent for support and the top leg straight and aligned with your body. Rest your head on your arm comfortably.
exercises.end_pose_description: The individual is still lying on their side with the bottom leg bent for support. The top leg is straight and elevated directly upwards from the hip, forming an angle of approximately 45-60 degrees with the horizontal plane of the body, indicating engagement of the gluteus medius and minimus. The head rests comfortably on the arm.

exercises.name: Patellar Tendon Strap Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Sit on a chair with one leg extended and a resistance band wrapped around the upper calf just below the knee. Keep good posture and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The leg is fully straightened and held straight, with the knee cap pulled upwards and the quadriceps muscles on the front of the thigh visibly tensed. The foot is slightly elevated from the floor due to the full extension against the resistance band.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms spread out to the sides in a T-position. Your spine should be neutral and relaxed against the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Both knees are bent, stacked together, and dropped fully to one side of the body, with the outer thigh and hip resting on the floor. The lower back and hips are rotated, while the upper back and shoulders remain flat on the floor, arms still outstretched in a T-position. The obliques, lower back, and outer glutes are visibly stretched in this twisted posture.

exercises.name: Standing Lateral Band Walk
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Slightly bend your knees and lean forward with a neutral spine, maintaining tension in the band.
exercises.end_pose_description: The lead leg is abducted widely to the side, its knee still slightly bent, while the other leg remains in its initial bent-knee position. The torso maintains its forward lean and neutral spine. The resistance band is fully taut, clearly engaging the gluteus medius and minimus on both hips, with the outer thigh of the lead leg under significant tension.

exercises.name: Prone Superman Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on your stomach with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Your forehead rests on the floor in a neutral neck position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your torso, arms, and legs are simultaneously elevated several inches off the floor. Your arms remain extended overhead, legs straight, and head in a neutral neck position, with the back muscles, glutes, and hamstrings visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Rotation with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band looped around a fixed point at chest height. Cross your arms over your chest while holding the band with tension.
exercises.end_pose_description: The torso is fully rotated to one side, with the chest facing perpendicular to the initial forward-facing position. The seated posture remains upright, and the arms are still crossed over the chest, holding the resistance band tightly taut, with the band now pulling from the side opposite the rotation. The obliques on the rotated side are visibly contracted, while the opposing obliques and the thoracic spine are notably stretched.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W Raises with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down with a resistance band underneath you and both ends held in your hands at shoulder level. Your forehead rests on the floor and core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your forehead is lifted slightly off the floor, with your gaze directed downward, maintaining a neutral spine. Both arms are fully extended, elevated significantly off the floor, with the resistance band taut and your thumbs pointing towards the ceiling. The muscles of your upper back and shoulders, including the posterior deltoids, rhomboids, and trapezius, are intensely contracted, and your shoulder blades are maximally retracted and depressed.

exercises.name: Standing Balance Hold
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with light fingertip contact on a chair or counter for light balance support if needed. Keep your eyes focused on a fixed point ahead of you.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand balanced on one foot, with the opposite foot lifted a few inches from the floor, knee gently bent. Maintain a level pelvis and keep the standing leg straight but not locked, actively engaging the muscles of the standing ankle and calf for stability. Your eyes remain focused on the fixed point, with the core and gluteal muscles visibly engaged to maintain an upright posture.

exercises.name: Shin Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Kneel on a padded mat and sit your glutes back slightly toward your heels with the tops of your feet flat on the ground behind you. Keep your torso upright and place your hands behind you on the mat.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your glutes are lifted off your heels, with your weight balanced slightly forward over your knees. The tops of your feet are flat on the ground behind you, and your torso is upright. Your hands are placed behind you on the mat, providing stability. The anterior lower leg muscles, including the tibialis anterior, are visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing away from a bench or elevated surface with one foot elevated behind you on the bench, holding dumbbells at your sides. Your front leg is straight with feet positioned to allow for a deep lunge.
exercises.end_pose_description: The body is lowered until the front thigh is roughly parallel to the ground, with the front knee deeply bent and the shin vertical. The rear knee is also bent, hovering just above the ground, with the hip flexors of the rear leg visibly stretched. The glutes and quadriceps of the front leg are strongly engaged, maintaining an upright torso with dumbbells held at the sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with a slight bend in your knees. Your shoulders are back and your core is braced.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your torso is leaned forward, nearly parallel to the floor, with your back straight and core braced. Your hips are fully hinged backward, and your knees maintain a slight bend, keeping your hamstrings and glutes visibly stretched. The dumbbells hang straight down, positioned around mid-shin level, close to your legs, with your spinal erectors engaged to maintain a flat back.

exercises.name: Single Leg Balance with Dumbbell Hold
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg. Your non-standing knee is lifted to hip height, creating an athletic stance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your standing leg maintains a slight knee bend, with the quadriceps and glutes visibly engaged for stability. The torso leans forward, nearly parallel to the floor, while the non-standing leg extends straight backward, also parallel to the floor. The dumbbell arm hangs naturally toward the floor, and the core muscles are contracted to hold this balanced posture.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up with Knee Drive
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a bench or step, holding dumbbells at your sides with your feet hip-width apart. Your posture is upright and you're positioned to step up onto the elevated surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: One foot is firmly planted on the elevated surface, with the knee of that leg slightly bent and the glutes and quadriceps visibly engaged. The opposite knee is driven high towards the chest, with the hip flexors visibly contracted, and its foot is elevated off the ground. Your posture remains upright, facing forward, holding the dumbbells at your sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise to Single Leg Stand
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms straight. Your non-standing leg is lightly touching the ground for light balance support if needed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Both arms are raised straight out to your sides, parallel to the floor, holding the dumbbells. Your non-standing leg is lifted off the ground with the knee bent and thigh parallel to the floor; the deltoids and gluteal muscles of your standing leg are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: External Rotation with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your right elbow bent to 90 degrees against your side and a resistance band around your wrist. Your forearm points forward across your body.
exercises.end_pose_description: Sit upright with your right elbow bent to 90 degrees against your side and a stretched resistance band around your wrist. Your forearm points directly forward, away from your body, with the back of your hand facing forward. The infraspinatus and teres minor muscles are visibly contracted.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-ups
exercises.pose_description: Position yourself in a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line. Keep your elbows locked and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The upper body is elevated away from the floor, with a slight dome in the upper back and the shoulder blades maximally protracted. Your hands remain directly under your shoulders, elbows locked, and core engaged, maintaining a straight line from heels to head through the rest of the body. The serratus anterior muscles are visibly engaged, and the rhomboids are stretched across the upper back.

exercises.name: Quadruped Shoulder Rocks
exercises.pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The hips are positioned back towards the heels, with hands fixed on the floor directly under the original shoulder line. The arms are fully extended, creating a deep stretch through the shoulders and the sides of the torso. The spine is neutral and the core is engaged, with the latissimus dorsi and posterior deltoids visibly stretched.

exercises.name: Planks with Shoulder Taps
exercises.pose_description: Hold a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders, body in a straight line, and core fully engaged. Keep your hips stable and avoid rotating.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain a plank position with one hand lifted and placed on the opposite shoulder. Your body remains in a straight line, supported by the other hand directly under its shoulder. The core and glutes are fully engaged, preventing any hip rotation, while the supporting shoulder and arm muscles are visibly working to stabilize the body.

exercises.name: Band-Resisted Shoulder External Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at elbow height with your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your side. Your forearm is positioned across your body horizontally.
exercises.end_pose_description: The forearm is positioned horizontally, pointing directly away from the body. The elbow remains bent at 90 degrees and pressed against your side. The posterior shoulder muscles, including the infraspinatus and teres minor, are visibly engaged.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge with Band Loop
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Your arms are at your sides with palms down for stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your hips are lifted off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees. Your glutes and hamstrings are visibly contracted, and the resistance band is taut above your knees, indicating engagement of the hip abductors. Your arms remain at your sides with palms down, and your feet are still flat on the floor, hip-width apart.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch with Band Assist
exercises.pose_description: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you, placing a resistance band around the ball of one foot while holding the band's ends. Your back is upright and your other leg is relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your hands are pulling the resistance band taut, which brings the ball of your banded foot and toes deeply back towards your shin. Your ankle is in full dorsiflexion, creating a prominent stretch along the posterior lower leg, including the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles. Your back remains upright, and your other leg is relaxed.

exercises.name: Quadruped Hip Circles with Band
exercises.pose_description: Begin on your hands and knees with a resistance band looped around one knee, positioned on your forearms for added support. Your hips are directly over your knees and your core is braced.
exercises.end_pose_description: The working leg's hip is in full extension and abduction, with the bent knee lifted as high as possible towards the ceiling, placing the resistance band under tension. The gluteus maximus and gluteus medius of the working leg are visibly engaged, while the core remains braced to stabilize the torso and pelvis over the supporting leg.

exercises.name: Banded Monster Walk
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees, feet shoulder-width apart, and hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. Maintain a quarter-squat position with a slight forward lean.
exercises.end_pose_description: The upper body maintains the quarter-squat and slight forward lean, with hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. One foot is positioned laterally, creating a wide stance where the feet are significantly wider than shoulder-width, while the other foot remains grounded. The resistance band is taut and highly stretched between the legs, signaling intense engagement of the gluteus medius and minimus, with the gluteus maximus and quadriceps visibly contracted to maintain the squat.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down on a table with your arms hanging off the edge, holding a resistance band in both hands with your arms at your sides. Your forehead rests on a small towel and your core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: The individual remains face-down on the table, forehead resting on the towel, with the core engaged. Both arms are extended straight forward and upward, reaching parallel to the floor, holding the resistance band taut. The anterior deltoids are visibly contracted, and the shoulder blades are upwardly rotated.

exercises.name: Happy Baby Pose
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent toward your chest and feet off the ground. Grasp the outer edges of your feet with your hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press your knees toward your armpits while keeping your lower back on the ground. Rock side to side gently to release tension in the pelvic floor.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Floor Relaxation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Let your arms rest at your sides with palms facing up.
exercises.end_pose_description: Focus on consciously relaxing all tension from your pelvic floor muscles while maintaining slow, deep breathing. Imagine the muscles softening and releasing with each exhale.

exercises.name: Recumbent Figure Four
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure-four shape.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull the thigh of the bottom leg toward your chest while keeping your head and shoulders relaxed on the ground. Hold to feel a deep stretch in the hip and pelvic floor region.

exercises.name: Kegel Exercise (Pelvic Floor Contraction)
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably on a chair or mat with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. Relax your pelvic floor muscles completely.
exercises.end_pose_description: Contract the pelvic floor muscles as if stopping the flow of urine, holding the contraction for 3-5 seconds. Release and relax for 5 seconds before repeating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Deadlift
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip. Keep your chest up, shoulders back, and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hinge at the hips while keeping your back straight and lowering the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive through your heels to return to standing position.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Floor With Dumbbell Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a light dumbbell placed on your lower abdomen. Relax your entire pelvic floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Contract your pelvic floor muscles while gently pressing down on the dumbbell with your lower abdomen for 3-5 seconds. Release and rest before repeating.

exercises.name: Standing Pelvic Tilts
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands on your hips. Maintain a neutral spine with shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tilt your pelvis forward and backward in a controlled manner, engaging your core with each movement. Focus on the pelvic floor engagement during the posterior tilt.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall with feet hip-width apart and hands on the wall at shoulder height. Your body should form a diagonal line from head to heels.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend your elbows to lower your upper body toward the wall while engaging your core. Push through your hands to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Muscle Contractions (Kegels)
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably in a chair with feet flat on the floor, maintaining neutral spine posture. Relax all abdominal and leg muscles.
exercises.end_pose_description: Contract the pelvic floor muscles as if stopping the flow of urine, holding the contraction for 3-5 seconds. Release and rest for 5 seconds between repetitions.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Glute Activation
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Maintain a slight forward lean from the hips.
exercises.end_pose_description: Step one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping toes pointing forward and chest upright. Return to center and repeat, feeling the outer glute engage.

exercises.name: Deep Core Activation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band wrapped around your torso at the level of your ribs. Hands are under shoulders and knees under hips.
exercises.end_pose_description: Exhale and draw your navel toward your spine, engaging the deep core muscles while maintaining neutral spine. Hold for 5 seconds while gently resisting the band, then release.

exercises.name: Transverse Abdominis Engagement
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Place your hands on your lower abdomen below the navel.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale to prepare, then exhale while drawing the lower abdominal wall inward and upward toward the spine. Hold this contraction for 5 seconds while breathing normally, then relax.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Clamshells
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Stack your hips and keep your feet together with knees bent at 45 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Keeping feet together, open the top knee against the band resistance while maintaining neutral spine alignment. Squeeze the outer glute and hip at the top, then slowly close.

exercises.name: Seated Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands placed behind the head or crossed over chest. Engage your core lightly.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently arch the back and lift the chest forward while looking slightly upward, then reverse by rounding the spine and tucking the chin. Move slowly between positions.

exercises.name: Bridge Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees through shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top while maintaining core engagement.

exercises.name: Modified Dumbbell Chest Press
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and dumbbells held at chest level with elbows at 90 degrees. Keep your lower back neutral against the mat.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until arms are nearly straight, maintaining a slight bend in the elbows. Lower controlled with tension in the chest and core.

exercises.name: Glute Squeeze with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level. Maintain good posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Perform a small squat by bending knees slightly, then powerfully squeeze your glutes as you return to standing, pressing through your heels. Contract your glutes maximally at the top.

exercises.name: Supported Wall Push-Up
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall about 18 inches away with feet hip-width apart and hands placed on the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the wall in a controlled manner, then push through your palms to return to start. Maintain core engagement throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Relaxation Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place one hand on your chest and one on your lower abdomen.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale through your nose for 4 counts, allowing your abdomen to expand and pelvic floor to relax downward. Exhale slowly for 6 counts, maintaining relaxation without clenching.

exercises.name: Deep Abdominal Engagement
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands resting on your lower abdomen. Breathe normally and relax your abdominal muscles.
exercises.end_pose_description: Exhale and gently draw your lower abdomen inward as if pulling your navel toward your spine, without holding your breath. Maintain this gentle engagement for 5-10 seconds while breathing freely.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Floor Engagement
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back on a firm surface with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep arms at your sides with palms down.
exercises.end_pose_description: While maintaining pelvic floor contractions, gently press your lower back toward the floor and hold for 3-5 seconds. Release both the pelvic floor and back press, then rest before repeating.

exercises.name: Seated Marching with Pelvic Floor Activation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and hands resting on your thighs. Maintain good posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one knee up toward your chest while simultaneously contracting your pelvic floor muscles. Lower the leg while releasing, then alternate sides in a controlled marching motion.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge with Pelvic Floor Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Position feet about 12 inches from your buttocks.
exercises.end_pose_description: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while squeezing your glutes and pelvic floor muscles simultaneously. Hold at the top for 2-3 seconds, maintaining even weight distribution across both feet.

exercises.name: Deep Abdominal Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with feet flat on the floor and one hand on your chest and one on your abdomen. Maintain relaxed shoulders and neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly inhale through your nose, feeling your abdomen expand while keeping your chest still. Exhale slowly through your mouth while gently engaging your deep abdominal muscles and pelvic floor.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises with Pelvic Floor Engagement
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on a sturdy chair or wall for light support and balance. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet while simultaneously contracting your pelvic floor muscles for 2-3 seconds. Lower your heels back down with control while releasing the pelvic floor contraction.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Sets with Pelvic Floor Activation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg extended flat and the other knee slightly bent with foot flat on the floor. Place a small rolled towel under the extended leg's knee if needed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tighten the thigh muscle of the extended leg by straightening the knee fully while simultaneously engaging pelvic floor muscles. Hold the contraction for 3-5 seconds, then release both the quad and pelvic floor.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Flexor Engagement
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture maintained with shoulders back. Keep both hands resting on your thighs.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one knee slightly off the chair while contracting your pelvic floor and maintaining upright posture. Hold briefly, then lower back down with control before switching sides.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Activation - Kegel Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable position with feet flat on the floor. Relax all muscles and take a deep breath to center yourself.
exercises.end_pose_description: Contract the pelvic floor muscles by squeezing as if stopping the flow of urine, hold for 3-5 seconds, then fully relax. Feel the muscles engage and release with each repetition.

exercises.name: Happy Baby Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bring one or both knees toward your chest, grasping the shins or behind the thighs.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hold both knees toward your chest while keeping your lower back flat on the ground, allowing the hips and pelvic floor to relax deeply. Breathe slowly and allow gravity to deepen the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge with Pelvic Floor Engagement
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, arms at your sides. Engage your core and prepare to activate your pelvic floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while engaging the pelvic floor muscles. Hold the bridge position with glutes and pelvic floor engaged for 2-3 seconds before lowering.

exercises.name: Supported Deep Squat
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall or sturdy support with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on the wall for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lower into a deep squat position with weight in your heels, allowing your pelvic floor and hip muscles to open and relax. Hold this stretch while maintaining balance with your hands on the support.

exercises.name: Supine Butterfly Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall open to the sides. Rest your arms at your sides with palms up.
exercises.end_pose_description: Allow gravity to gently open your hips and inner thighs while your lower back remains relaxed on the ground. Breathe deeply and hold this restorative stretch to release pelvic floor tension.

exercises.name: Prone Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down with forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders. One leg should be bent with knee toward your glute, while the other extends behind you.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press your hips gently into the ground to deepen the stretch in the extended leg's hip flexor and quadriceps. Hold this stretch while breathing steadily to release tension in the pelvic region.

exercises.name: Gaze Stabilization - Horizontal
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level. Keep your head still and relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly move your head side to side while keeping your eyes fixed on the same point. Your head moves but your gaze remains locked on the target.

exercises.name: Gaze Stabilization - Vertical
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level. Maintain a neutral head position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly move your head up and down while keeping your eyes locked on the same fixed point. Your head follows a vertical path but your gaze stays steady.

exercises.name: Heel-Toe Taps
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides or on a countertop for light support. Look straight ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rapidly tap your heels on the ground while keeping your toes elevated, then alternate by tapping your toes while heels stay down. Maintain a steady rhythm for the duration of the exercise.

exercises.name: Vestibular Walk
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with proper posture and arms at your sides. Choose a clear walking path in front of you.
exercises.end_pose_description: Walk forward slowly while keeping your eyes focused on a fixed point at eye level ahead. Maintain steady, controlled steps and upright posture throughout the walk.

exercises.name: Quadruped Head Turns
exercises.pose_description: Start on hands and knees with shoulders stacked over wrists and hips over knees. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to look over your shoulder toward one hip. Hold briefly before returning to center and repeating on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Balance Ball Sitting
exercises.pose_description: Sit on a balance/stability ball with feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart. Maintain an upright posture with neutral spine alignment.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hold the seated position on the ball while engaging your core to maintain stability. Keep your shoulders relaxed and look straight ahead.

exercises.name: Seated Marching with Head Turns
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Keep your head facing forward with arms relaxed at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift one knee up toward your chest while simultaneously turning your head to look over the opposite shoulder. Alternate legs with each head turn.

exercises.name: Standing Balance with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Hands can be on hips or extended forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slightly bend your knees while maintaining tension on the band and shift your weight onto one leg. Hold for 2 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion and Extension with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around the back of your head and held in both hands at chest level. Keep your shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull the band forward to flex your neck, bringing your chin toward your chest. Release and return to neutral position, moving slowly and controlled.

exercises.name: Quadruped Alternating Limb Raises
exercises.pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Extend your right arm forward and left leg backward to form a straight line with your body. Hold for 2 seconds, return to start, and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Supine Head Turns with Stabilization
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Rest your arms at your sides with eyes focused on the ceiling.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to one side, keeping your eyes open and focused. Pause briefly, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Rolls with Band Resistance
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with a resistance band held taut across your shoulders at mid-chest height, hands gripping the band at shoulder width. Keep your core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Roll your shoulders backward against the band resistance while maintaining tension. Complete the circular motion and return to start, focusing on smooth controlled movement.

exercises.name: Standing Single-Leg Stance with Band Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall or sturdy surface with a resistance band looped around a post at waist height for light support. Feet are together.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift one leg slightly off the ground and balance on the standing leg while maintaining light contact with the band. Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Prone Neck Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and forehead resting on a towel. Engage your core to stabilize your spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently lift your head and neck slightly off the ground, creating a neutral alignment with your spine. Hold this position for 5-10 seconds without strain, then relax and repeat.

exercises.name: Head Turns with Fixed Gaze
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your head in a neutral position and your eyes focused on a fixed point at eye level. Keep your shoulders relaxed and facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head left and right while maintaining your gaze on the fixed point. Your eyes should stay locked on the target as your head rotates.

exercises.name: Standing Weight Shifts
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides or lightly touching a counter for light support if needed. Look straight ahead and maintain an upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Shift your body weight slowly to one side, feeling the pressure increase through that foot. Return to center and shift to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Seated Head Nods
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your head in neutral position and eyes looking forward. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your back supported by the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly nod your head up and down in a gentle, controlled motion. Move only your head while keeping your shoulders still and your gaze forward.

exercises.name: Standing Figure 8 Walking
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with good posture and eyes focused on a point ahead. Identify a space where you can walk a figure-8 pattern slowly, staying near a wall or furniture for safety.
exercises.end_pose_description: Walk a slow figure-8 pattern, turning your head and body naturally with the movement. Keep your movements controlled and deliberate, maintaining focus on your path.

exercises.name: Seated Eye Circles
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your head still and neutral, eyes open and facing forward. Keep your neck relaxed and shoulders in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Move your eyes in slow, smooth circles clockwise and counterclockwise. Keep your head completely still while tracing an imaginary circle with your eyes only.

exercises.name: Scapular Stabilization with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, squeezing the trapezius muscles, then slowly lower back down. Maintain neutral spine throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder Y-T-W
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or elevated surface with arms hanging down on either side. Rest your forehead on a towel to maintain neutral cervical spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise your arms in Y, T, and W positions sequentially, engaging upper back muscles. Return to starting position between each variation with controlled movement.

exercises.name: Gaze Stabilization Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a target (finger or object) at eye level 12 inches away. Keep your head still initially.
exercises.end_pose_description: Keep your eyes fixed on the target while slowly moving your head side to side in a controlled manner. Maintain focus on the target throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Upper Back Dumbbell Rows
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbells up toward your ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower with control while maintaining neutral cervical spine.

exercises.name: Proprioceptive Head Tracking
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with arms at your sides. Focus on a fixed point at eye level in front of you.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to look at objects in different directions while standing on one leg. Return to center and switch legs to challenge proprioception.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a bench with dumbbells held at shoulder height with elbows bent. Maintain neutral spinal alignment and engage your core.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner without arching your lower back. Lower back to shoulder height with control.

exercises.name: Gaze Stabilization - X1 (Visual Fixation)
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, facing forward with a fixed target (letter or object) at eye level on a wall about 3 feet away. Keep your head still and focus on the target.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain steady visual fixation on the target while your head remains completely stationary. Your eyes should not move from the target point.

exercises.name: Gaze Stabilization - Head Turns (VOR Exercise)
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, facing a fixed target at eye level on the wall. Hold your gaze on the target with your head in neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head side to side (approximately 30 degrees each direction) while maintaining visual focus on the target. Keep your eyes fixed on the target as your head moves.

exercises.name: Balance Walk - Tandem Stance
exercises.pose_description: Standing in a STATIC tandem stance pose: both feet planted firmly on the floor in a single straight line, with the heel of the front foot touching the toe of the back foot. Arms are extended out to the sides at shoulder height for balance. Both feet are flat on the floor, NOT walking, NOT lifted, NOT mid-step. The figure is holding a still balance pose, gaze forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the tandem stance (one foot in front of the other) for 20-30 seconds without losing balance. Focus on a fixed visual target to help stabilize your position.

exercises.name: Single Leg Stance - Dynamic
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg with the other knee lifted to hip height, with hands on your hips or extended to the sides for balance. Keep your focus on a fixed point ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hold the single-leg stance for 20-30 seconds while maintaining upright posture and a fixed gaze. Your standing leg should be slightly bent at the knee for stability.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walking - Progressive Speed
exercises.pose_description: Stand on a treadmill at a slow comfortable walking speed (2-3 mph) with hands lightly on the rails. Focus your gaze straight ahead at eye level.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gradually increase the treadmill speed to a brisk walking pace (3.5-4.5 mph) while maintaining forward gaze. Maintain upright posture and stable head position throughout.

exercises.name: Quadruped Rocking - Head Turns
exercises.pose_description: Get on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Look down at the floor between your hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rock your body backward toward your heels while slowly turning your head to look over your shoulder, then return to center. Alternate head turns with each rocking motion.

exercises.name: Standing Head Tilts - Visual Focus
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart facing a fixed target at eye level on the wall. Keep your body still and focus intently on the target.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly tilt your head to one side (ear toward shoulder) while keeping your eyes focused on the fixed target, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand - Head Turns
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor hip-width apart and hands crossed over your chest. Look straight ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand up from the chair while simultaneously turning your head to one side, then sit back down and repeat on the opposite side. Maintain controlled movement throughout.

exercises.name: Tandem Walk - Heel to Toe
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together, ready to walk in a straight line with one foot placed directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe pattern. Keep arms out to the sides for balance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Walk forward slowly in a tandem stance, placing the heel of one foot directly in front of the toes of the other foot. Maintain focus on a fixed point ahead while walking.

exercises.name: Horizontal Head Turns with Focus
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Fix your gaze on a target object at eye level directly in front of you.
exercises.end_pose_description: Turn your head slowly to one side while keeping your eyes focused on the target as long as possible before following with your eyes. Return to center and repeat to the opposite side.

exercises.name: Vertical Head Nods with Fixation
exercises.pose_description: Stand with good posture, feet hip-width apart, looking straight ahead at a focal point. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly nod your head up and down while maintaining focus on a fixed point on the wall. Move through a comfortable range of motion.

exercises.name: Diagonal Gaze Shifts
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and your head in neutral position. Focus on a target straight ahead at eye level.
exercises.end_pose_description: Shift your gaze diagonally to upper-right, then lower-left in a smooth, controlled manner. Alternate directions and repeat for the prescribed repetitions.

exercises.name: Band-Resisted Head Stabilization
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and place a resistance band around your head at forehead level, holding both ends behind your head. Maintain neutral head position with eyes focused forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Apply gentle resistance with your hands while keeping your head perfectly still and your gaze fixed on a target. Hold for 5 seconds then release.

exercises.name: Standing Gaze Stability with Head Movement
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, eyes focused on a target at eye level. Keep your arms at your sides or slightly out for balance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Move your head in slow circles while maintaining continuous focus on a fixed target. Keep your gaze locked on the target as your head rotates around it.

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Neck Isometric with Gaze Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around your head, anchoring it to your hands positioned at shoulder height. Fix your eyes on a point directly ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently push your head against the band resistance while keeping your gaze perfectly stable on the target. Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.

exercises.name: X-Pattern Gaze Tracking
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall with an X-pattern drawn or imagined on it. Position yourself at a comfortable viewing distance with your gaze at the center.
exercises.end_pose_description: Smoothly move your eyes along each line of the X pattern from center outward and back. Keep your head still while only your eyes move.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance Gaze Stabilization
exercises.pose_description: Stand in a tandem stance (one foot directly in front of the other) with arms out for balance. Focus your gaze on a fixed target at eye level.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain the challenging balance position while keeping your eyes locked on the target and slowly turning your head side to side. Keep gaze stable throughout.

exercises.name: Seated Head Turns
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes focused straight ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to one side, bringing your chin toward your shoulder without forcing it. Hold briefly and return to center.

exercises.name: Standing Single-Leg Stance
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart near a wall or sturdy chair for safety support. Keep your arms ready to grasp support if needed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Shift your weight onto one leg and lift the opposite foot slightly off the ground, maintaining an upright posture. Keep your eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.

exercises.name: Seated Deep Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed down and back. Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale deeply through your nose, feeling your belly expand, then exhale slowly through your mouth. Focus on controlled, intentional breathing.

exercises.name: Seated Eye Tracking
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and head still, focusing straight ahead. Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly move your eyes to follow an imaginary point in different directions (up, down, left, right, diagonals) without moving your head. Track smoothly and controlled.

exercises.name: Seated Quad Sets
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your back against the chair for support.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on one leg by straightening it, lifting the heel slightly off the ground. Hold briefly, then relax and repeat on the opposite leg.

exercises.name: Standing Marching with Head Stability
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Keep your gaze fixed on a point at eye level directly ahead of you.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one knee up to hip height while maintaining a steady gaze and upright posture. Keep your head still and level throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Seated Head Turns with Fixation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Look straight ahead at a fixed point.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to one side while keeping your eyes focused on a stationary object at eye level. Hold the position for 2-3 seconds before returning to center.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squats with Visual Focus
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Fix your gaze on a stable point ahead at eye level.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees while maintaining your forward gaze and keeping your chest upright. Push through your heels to return to standing position.

exercises.name: Bird Dog with Stability Hold
exercises.pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your head in a neutral position looking down at the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg backward until both are parallel to the floor. Maintain a level spine and neutral head position, holding for 2-3 seconds.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry with Head Level
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a firm grip. Keep your head level and your gaze focused straight ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Walk forward slowly while maintaining an upright posture and steady gaze. Keep your shoulders level and your core engaged throughout the walk.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your back straight and your gaze directed ahead. Keep your shoulders relaxed and stationary.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly drop your chin toward your chest, then gently tilt your head back to look toward the ceiling. Move within a comfortable range without forcing the motion.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Rows with Stability
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended down in front of you. Maintain an upright posture with your gaze fixed ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest by driving your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your core engaged and your head level throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Gentle Jaw Opening with Tongue on Palate
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your back against a chair and shoulders relaxed. Place your tongue on the roof of your mouth behind your upper front teeth.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly open your mouth about 1-2 inches while keeping your tongue pressed against the palate. Hold this position for 2-3 seconds without straining.

exercises.name: Resisted Jaw Opening with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and loop a light resistance band around your chin. Hold the ends of the band with both hands at chest level with slight tension.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently open your mouth against the band resistance for 2-3 seconds. Return slowly to the starting position without closing your teeth completely.

exercises.name: Lateral Jaw Glide Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and teeth lightly touching in neutral position. Place your index finger on your chin for guidance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly slide your lower jaw to one side 1-2 centimeters without opening your mouth. Hold for 2 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Neck Stretching with Gentle Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your jaw relaxed with teeth slightly apart.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder, dropping your chin slightly. Hold the gentle stretch for 15-20 seconds and feel the tension in your neck muscles.

exercises.name: Submental Isometric Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and place your index and middle fingers under your chin. Keep your mouth closed with teeth lightly touching.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press your chin downward against your fingers while resisting with your hand, creating an isometric contraction. Hold for 5 seconds without moving your jaw.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs and Relaxation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with arms at your sides and shoulders relaxed. Keep your neck neutral and jaw unclenched.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise both shoulders toward your ears, hold for 2 seconds, then drop them down quickly while exhaling. Repeat 10 times to release tension.

exercises.name: Tongue Strengthening Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and teeth together lightly. Position your tongue tip against the roof of your mouth.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press your tongue firmly against the hard palate while holding your mouth closed. Maintain firm pressure for 5-10 seconds then relax.

exercises.name: Jaw Relaxation and Gentle Opening
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Allow your mouth to close gently with teeth slightly apart.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly open your mouth 1-2 inches without forcing, keeping tension-free. Hold briefly before returning to starting position.

exercises.name: Neck Isometric with Band Support
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and place a resistance band around the back of your head at ear level. Hold both ends of the band with your hands near your temples.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press your head forward against the band resistance without moving, maintaining tension for 5-10 seconds while keeping jaw relaxed.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band under both feet. Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift both shoulders toward your ears against the band resistance, hold briefly, then lower back down with control.

exercises.name: Lateral Neck Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your gaze forward with both feet flat on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a mild stretch along the left side of your neck. Hold without bouncing.

exercises.name: Resisted Jaw Closure
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open. Place your index finger gently under your chin.
exercises.end_pose_description: Apply light downward resistance with your finger while slowly closing your mouth, engaging the jaw muscles without clenching.

exercises.name: Upper Back Extension with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and wrap a resistance band around a fixed point at chest height. Hold both ends with arms extended forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, maintaining upright posture and relaxed jaw throughout.

exercises.name: Forehead Wrinkle Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with your face relaxed and looking straight ahead. Keep your eyebrows in their natural resting position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise your eyebrows as high as possible, creating horizontal wrinkles across your forehead. Hold this position while maintaining the contraction in the forehead muscles.

exercises.name: Eye Closure and Blinking
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with eyes open, looking straight ahead in a relaxed manner. Keep your face still and avoid any compensatory movements.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly close both eyes as tightly as possible, squinting hard to engage the orbicularis oculi muscles. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds before slowly releasing.

exercises.name: Smile with Mouth Closed
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and lips together in a neutral position. Your face should be completely relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Draw the corners of your mouth upward into a gentle smile while keeping your lips closed. Try to engage both sides of your face equally, noting any asymmetry.

exercises.name: Mouth Opening Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth gently closed and face relaxed. Keep your jaw in a neutral position without tension.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly open your mouth as wide as comfortable, dropping your jaw downward and feeling the stretch across your lower face. Hold briefly and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Cheek Puff Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth closed and cheeks in their natural relaxed state. Keep your lips sealed but not pressed tightly together.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale through your nose and puff out both cheeks with air, stretching the buccinator muscles. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then slowly release the air through pursed lips.

exercises.name: Lip Rounding Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth relaxed and lips in a neutral position. Your face should be calm with no tension in the perioral muscles.
exercises.end_pose_description: Round your lips as if saying the letter 'O', bringing them forward and together in a tight pucker. Focus on engaging the orbicularis oris muscle symmetrically on both sides.

exercises.name: Neck ROM - Gentle Turns
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture, shoulders relaxed, and head facing forward. Keep your shoulders still throughout the movement.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to one side as far as comfortable, looking over your shoulder. Hold briefly, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Flyes
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides. Hinge slightly at the hips with a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise both dumbbells out to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows until your arms are parallel to the ground. Squeeze your rear shoulder muscles at the top of the movement.

exercises.name: Neck Lateral Flexion Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with both feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Your head is in neutral position facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a stretch along the left side of your neck. Your opposite shoulder remains relaxed and down.

exercises.name: Temporomandibular Joint Mobilization
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your mouth gently closed and jaw relaxed. Place your index and middle fingers on your chin.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly open your mouth while gently pressing downward on your chin with your fingers, creating gentle resistance. Move through a comfortable range of motion without pain.

exercises.name: Prone Cobra Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down on a mat with your palms flat under your shoulders and legs extended behind you. Your forehead is gently resting on the mat.
exercises.end_pose_description: Push through your hands to lift your chest off the ground while keeping your pelvis on the mat and neck in neutral alignment. Your gaze remains downward to maintain cervical spine safety.

exercises.name: Seated Resistance Band Rows
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with legs extended in front of you and a resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends with both hands at chest level, maintaining good posture with shoulders back.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your torso by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping elbows close to your body. Hold briefly at the chest, feeling the contraction in your back muscles.

exercises.name: Standing Lateral Band Walks
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Keep feet hip-width apart with a slight bend in your knees and hands on your hips.
exercises.end_pose_description: Step laterally to one side, maintaining tension on the band and keeping knees slightly bent. Your torso remains upright as you take controlled steps sideways.

exercises.name: Supine Glute Bridge with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms are at your sides with palms down.
exercises.end_pose_description: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders while maintaining band tension. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band anchored under both feet. Hold the band ends at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the band upward and slightly forward, extending your arms overhead while maintaining core stability. Lower back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Seated Upper Back Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and hold a resistance band at arm's length in front of you with hands shoulder-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull the band apart while rounding your upper back slightly, feeling a stretch across your shoulders and upper back. Hold this position while maintaining steady breathing.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright and loop a resistance band around one foot while holding the opposite end. Keep your core engaged and maintain upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull your foot toward your glute using the band, feeling a stretch along the front of your hip and thigh. Keep your knee pointing downward and avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Rotation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with a slight forward lean and hold both ends of a resistance band at chest height. Keep your feet flat on the floor and maintain a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, extending the band in front of you while keeping your hips stable. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side for controlled rotational movement.

exercises.name: Standing Bicep Curls with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band under both feet. Hold the band ends with palms facing forward and arms extended at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend your elbows and curl the band upward toward your shoulders, keeping upper arms stationary and maintaining good posture. Lower back to starting position with control.

exercises.name: Seated Quadriceps Strengthener with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around one foot. Keep the other foot flat on the floor and maintain upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Straighten the leg with the band by extending your knee fully, tightening your quadriceps muscle. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hip-width apart. Cross your arms over your chest with hands touching opposite shoulders.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, turning your shoulders and upper back while keeping hips facing forward. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes forward and spine neutral.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, then gently lift your gaze upward while extending the neck. Move in a controlled manner through the full range.

exercises.name: Big Arm Circles
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Make large circular motions with both arms moving forward in exaggerated, expansive circles. Complete full rotations with maximum range of motion, then reverse direction.

exercises.name: Big Steps Forward
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or holding light dumbbells. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Take an exaggerated large step forward, bending the front knee deeply while keeping the back knee nearly touching the ground. Step forward with purposeful, high-amplitude movements.

exercises.name: Big Backward Steps
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright facing forward with feet together and arms at your sides. Keep your core tight and posture tall.
exercises.end_pose_description: Take deliberate, large steps backward with exaggerated knee bending and hip extension. Emphasize the backward reach and amplitude of each step.

exercises.name: Big Arm Raises with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Maintain upright posture with engaged core.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead with a powerful, exaggerated movement, fully extending the arms above the head. Lower with control back to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Big Trunk Rotations
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms crossed over chest or extended out to sides. Maintain upright posture with slight knee bend.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate the torso maximally to one side with a big, exaggerated turning motion, then return to center. Alternate sides with full range of motion rotations.

exercises.name: Big Sit-to-Stand with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a sturdy chair holding dumbbells at shoulder height, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Lean slightly forward from the hips.
exercises.end_pose_description: Stand up with an exaggerated, powerful movement using leg and hip extension, fully extending the knees and hips. Lower back down with control.

exercises.name: Big Lateral Reaches with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout.
exercises.end_pose_description: Reach the dumbbell laterally and overhead in a large, sweeping arc, fully extending the arm across and upward. Return to starting position and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand Transfer
exercises.pose_description: Patient sits upright in a firm chair with feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Hands are placed on the seat beside the hips for support.
exercises.end_pose_description: Patient stands fully upright with knees extended and hips neutral, maintaining balance without hand support if possible. Weight is evenly distributed through both legs.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Flexion March
exercises.pose_description: Patient lies on their back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Arms are at the sides with palms down for stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Patient alternately lifts one knee toward the chest in a marching motion while keeping the opposite foot on the floor. Movement is controlled and rhythmic with the core engaged throughout.

exercises.name: Prone Knee Extension
exercises.pose_description: Patient lies face-down on a mat with hips flat and arms folded under the forehead for comfort. The affected leg is bent with the knee at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Patient straightens the affected leg by extending the knee fully while keeping the hip on the mat. The leg is held briefly at full extension before slowly returning to the bent position.

exercises.name: Seated Dorsiflexion
exercises.pose_description: Patient sits upright in a firm chair with both feet flat on the floor. The affected leg remains relaxed with the foot resting naturally on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Patient pulls the toes toward the shin, flexing the ankle joint while keeping the heel on the floor. The movement is slow and controlled, activating the anterior tibialis muscle.

exercises.name: Treadmill Gait Training
exercises.pose_description: Patient stands on a treadmill with feet hip-width apart, holding the handrails lightly for balance and safety. The machine is set at a slow speed appropriate for the patient's function level.
exercises.end_pose_description: Patient walks at a controlled pace with normalized gait pattern, focusing on symmetrical weight distribution and smooth step-over mechanics. Posture is upright and stride length is consistent throughout the duration.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Flexor Strengthening with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot while holding the other end in both hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift the banded leg upward, bringing the knee toward the chest against the band resistance. Hold briefly at the top of the movement with controlled tension.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Sets with Band Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with a small rolled towel under one knee. Loop a resistance band around the thigh just above the knee for added resistance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tighten the thigh muscle and press the back of the knee into the towel, straightening the leg. Hold the contraction for 5 seconds against the band tension.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Bridge Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Place a resistance band above the knees for added engagement.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling, engaging the glutes and core. Hold the bridge position while keeping the band tensioned between the knees.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Curl with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot and hold the ends in both hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl the banded leg backward, bringing the heel toward the glute against the band resistance. Maintain an upright seated position throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Standing Single Leg Balance with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or support surface with hands lightly on the support. Anchor a resistance band at waist height for added stability if needed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Shift weight to one leg and lift the opposite foot slightly off the ground, maintaining balance. Hold briefly, then lower and switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing Wall Holds
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart, approximately 6 inches away from the wall. Place your hands on the wall at chest height for light support.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture with your weight evenly distributed across both feet. Gradually reduce pressure on your hands to challenge your balance while keeping contact with the wall for safety.

exercises.name: Standing Single Leg Stand
exercises.pose_description: Stand next to a wall or counter with your hand resting lightly on it for support. Position your feet hip-width apart with your weight evenly distributed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Shift your weight onto one leg while lifting the other foot slightly off the ground. Maintain an upright posture and hold this position for 10-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your hands crossed in front of your chest and your shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently round your back and lean forward, letting your head and shoulders drop toward your knees. Hold this stretch and breathe deeply, feeling the lengthening along your spine and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing forward. Keep your core engaged and back neutral against the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly raise both dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion, extending your arms fully but without locking your elbows. Hold briefly at the top before returning to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Prone Hip Extension with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a mat with your forehead resting on your hands for comfort, legs extended straight behind you. Place a light dumbbell in the crook of one knee or hold it against your thigh.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift the leg holding the dumbbell upward, squeezing the glute muscle while keeping the knee slightly bent. Hold at the top for 2 seconds, then lower back down in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Seated Trunk Rotation with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a chair or bench with feet flat on the floor, holding one dumbbell at chest height with both hands, elbows bent. Keep your lower body stable and engage your core muscles.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping the dumbbell at chest level, then return to center and rotate to the opposite side. Move in a controlled manner, avoiding rapid twisting motions.

exercises.name: Standing Balance with Dumbbell Hold
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side with your arm extended. Keep your gaze focused on a fixed point ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain steady balance while slowly shifting your weight from one foot to the other in a controlled manner. Progress by closing your eyes briefly or standing on one leg if balance allows.

exercises.name: Seated Upper Extremity Reaches
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms resting at your sides. Keep your back against the chair for support and stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly raise one arm forward and upward, reaching at a comfortable level without full extension. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Seated Core Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and hands resting on your abdomen or thighs. Keep your shoulders relaxed and maintain proper posture against the chair back.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4, gently engaging your abdominal muscles, then exhale through your mouth for a count of 4. Focus on controlled breathing without excessive exertion to conserve energy.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Wrist Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up, holding one end of a resistance band looped under your foot. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table with the band creating light tension.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl your wrist upward against the band resistance, bringing your palm toward your inner forearm. Hold briefly at the top of the movement before slowly lowering back down.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pronation/Supination
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and hold a resistance band vertically with both hands, one end anchored under your foot. Your elbows stay bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms to turn your palms upward (supination), then rotate back to palms down (pronation), maintaining tension on the band throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Bicep Curl
