exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, standing on a resistance band with both feet. Hold the other end of the band in each hand with arms extended downward and palms facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl your hands upward toward your shoulders against the band resistance, keeping your elbows stationary. Squeeze briefly at the top before lowering back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Forearm Flexor Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your right arm extended in front of you at shoulder height with your palm facing down. Loop a resistance band around your fingers and hold the other end in your left hand.
exercises.end_pose_description: Use the band to gently pull your fingers back toward your wrist, extending the forearm flexor muscles. Feel a comfortable stretch along the underside of your forearm and hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Forearm Extensor Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your right arm extended in front of you at shoulder height with your palm facing up. Loop a resistance band around your fingers and hold the other end in your left hand.
exercises.end_pose_description: Use the band to gently pull your fingers down toward your wrist, stretching the forearm extensor muscles. Feel a comfortable stretch along the top of your forearm and hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Shoulder Mobility Band Pull-Apart
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at chest height about shoulder-width apart. Your arms are slightly bent and the band has light tension.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and slightly backward, opening your chest while keeping your arms at chest level. Slowly return the band to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Lying IT Band Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head neutral and arms at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull your right knee across your body toward your left shoulder using your hands, keeping your shoulders flat on the floor. Hold this position while feeling the stretch along the outer hip.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlifts with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, with a slight knee bend in the standing leg. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hinge forward at the hip while extending the non-standing leg behind you for balance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Return to standing by driving through the heel of the support leg.

exercises.name: Patellar Tendon Mobilization
exercises.pose_description: Sit with one leg extended and use your hands to gently grasp the area just below your kneecap. Keep the quad relaxed and the knee slightly bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently massage and mobilize the patellar tendon with controlled thumb or finger pressure, moving in small circles. Apply light to moderate pressure based on comfort level.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand on one leg while holding a dumbbell at your side, with a slight knee bend in the standing leg. Keep your core tight and focus on a fixed point ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Maintain single-leg balance while performing small controlled arm movements with the dumbbell. Keep the supporting knee soft and engaged throughout the hold.

exercises.name: Dead Bugs
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with arms extended straight up toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees, shins parallel to the ground. Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly extend one arm overhead while straightening the opposite leg, hovering both just above the ground. Return to start and alternate sides in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder External Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a bench with your right arm hanging off the side, elbow bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulder abducted at 90 degrees with your forearm pointing downward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your shoulder externally, raising your forearm upward toward the ceiling while keeping your elbow fixed at 90 degrees. Slowly lower back down with control and repeat for repetitions.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Radial Deviation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in neutral position, holding one end of a resistance band anchored under your opposite foot. Your thumb side faces upward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your wrist deviates toward the thumb side against the band resistance. The movement is small and controlled.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Ulnar Deviation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in neutral position, holding one end of a resistance band anchored under your opposite foot. Your pinky side faces upward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your wrist deviates toward the pinky side against the band resistance. The movement is small and controlled.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pronation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your body, palm facing upward. Hold a resistance band with both hands at the ends.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your forearm rotates so your palm faces downward against the band resistance. The upper arm remains stationary against your body.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Supination
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your body, palm facing downward. Hold a resistance band with both hands at the ends.
exercises.end_pose_description: Your forearm rotates so your palm faces upward against the band resistance. The upper arm remains stationary against your body.

exercises.name: Finger Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up with fingers extended. Your affected hand should be relaxed and supported by the table surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently curl your fingertips to hold a ball or soft object without moving, maintaining steady pressure for the duration. Keep your wrist neutral and avoid any bouncing or dynamic movement.

exercises.name: Finger Spread and Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your hand relaxed and fingers slightly together in front of you. Your palm should be facing downward in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly spread all fingers apart as wide as comfortable, creating space between each digit. Gently squeeze them back together without making a tight fist, focusing on controlled movement.

exercises.name: Finger Flexor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up with fingers relaxed. Your opposite hand is ready to assist with gentle pressure.
exercises.end_pose_description: Use your opposite hand to gently press the back of your extended fingers toward your body, creating a mild stretch in the palm and forearm. Hold the stretch position while maintaining relaxed breathing.

exercises.name: Extensor Carpi Radialis Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your arm extended in front of you, elbow straight, with your palm facing downward. Your opposite hand is positioned to apply gentle pressure.
exercises.end_pose_description: Use your opposite hand to gently press your extended hand downward toward the ground, creating a stretch along the top of your forearm. Keep your elbow straight and hold the stretch position.

exercises.name: Hip Internal Rotation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both feet just above the arches.
exercises.end_pose_description: Keeping your right foot planted, rotate your left knee inward toward the midline of your body against the band resistance. Return to center and repeat before switching sides.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your left side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees. Place a cushion or foam pad between your knees, positioned just above knee level.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze the pad with your inner thighs and hips, bringing your knees slightly closer together. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds while maintaining stable hip and pelvic positioning.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge Single Leg
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Lift one foot slightly off the ground and extend that leg slightly forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Drive through the heel of your planted foot to lift your hips high off the ground, maintaining a straight line from knee to shoulder. Squeeze your glutes at the top before lowering back down.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose Hip Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Start on all fours, then bring your right knee forward between your hands with your right foot flexed. Keep your left leg extended straight behind you with your hip square to the ground.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso toward your front leg while maintaining a neutral spine. Breathe deeply into the stretch of your right hip external rotators and piriformis muscle.

exercises.name: Monster Walks with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Maintain a slight forward lean with knees bent in a quarter-squat position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Take a step forward and slightly outward with one leg, keeping tension on the band and maintaining hip stability. Alternate legs in a controlled stepping pattern while keeping your torso upright.

exercises.name: Prone I-Y-T Raises with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down on a bench or table with your chest supported and feet on the ground, holding a resistance band in both hands with arms hanging down. Your forehead is neutral looking toward the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise your arms in three positions: I (straight overhead), Y (45-degree angle), and T (90-degree angle), squeezing your rear shoulder muscles at the peak of each movement.

exercises.name: Band-Resisted Shoulder Internal Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Stand with right side toward a fixed point where the band is anchored at elbow height. Bend your right elbow 90 degrees with upper arm against your ribs, forearm pointing outward, holding the band.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the band across your body using internal rotation, bringing your forearm toward your midline while keeping your elbow stationary. Control the return to start position.

exercises.name: Quadruped Shoulder Stabilization
exercises.pose_description: Start on hands and knees with hands shoulder-width apart and knees hip-width apart, maintaining a neutral spine. Shoulders are packed down with scapulae stable.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining stability through the opposite shoulder and core. Return and alternate sides with controlled movements.

exercises.name: Band Rows - High to Low
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a fixed anchor point with the band attached at high level, feet hip-width apart. Hold the band with both hands at shoulder height with arms extended.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the band down and toward your body by retracting your shoulder blades, bringing your hands to your ribcage level. Squeeze your back muscles and control the return.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion Lifts
exercises.pose_description: Lie face-down on a bench with your chest supported, feet anchored to the floor, and arms hanging straight down holding a resistance band. Your forehead is neutral and core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise your arms forward and upward to shoulder height against the band resistance, leading with your thumbs. Squeeze your shoulder muscles and control the descent back to start.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Flexor Marching
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor and good posture. Keep your core engaged and back against the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one knee toward your chest in a controlled marching motion, then lower it back down. Alternate legs in a slow, deliberate rhythm, focusing on smooth hip flexion without compensating with your back.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexion with Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a sturdy chair or counter with both hands lightly touching it for balance. Maintain upright posture with feet hip-width apart.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly lift one knee forward and upward to hip height in a controlled manner. Hold briefly at the top, then lower your leg back down without letting your foot touch the floor completely before the next repetition.

exercises.name: Knee to Chest Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly pull one knee toward your chest with your hands and hold it there gently for the prescribed duration. Keep your other leg extended and your lower back in contact with the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Deadlifts
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms straight. Your chest is upright and core is engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hinge at the hips and slightly bend your knees while lowering the dumbbells toward the ground, keeping your back straight and chest forward. Return to standing by driving through your heels.

exercises.name: Supported Child's Pose
exercises.pose_description: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels, placing a foam roller or pillow under your chest for support. Let your arms rest alongside your body.
exercises.end_pose_description: Allow your torso to rest completely on the support with your forehead relaxed downward. Breathe deeply and let gravity gently stretch your thoracic and lumbar spine.

exercises.name: Neck Isometric Hold - Lateral
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and place your right hand against the right side of your head near your temple. Your head is in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press your head into your hand while resisting with equal force, creating an isometric contraction without allowing any head movement. Maintain the contraction while keeping your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Shoulder External Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your ribs. Your forearms point forward at the starting position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms outward against the band resistance, opening your chest and engaging your rotator cuff. Your elbows remain stationary against your ribs throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Thoracic Spine Extension Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and clasp your hands behind your head with elbows pointing outward. Your shoulders are relaxed and your spine is in neutral.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently arch your upper back backward while allowing your hands to support your head, opening up your chest and front shoulders. Avoid excessive neck extension by keeping your gaze slightly downward.

exercises.name: Band-Resisted Neck Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and place a resistance band around the back of your head, holding both ends of the band in your hands at chest level. Your head is in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently flex your neck forward against the band resistance, bringing your chin toward your chest in a controlled manner. Maintain steady resistance throughout the movement without jerking.

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your arms at your sides and shoulders relaxed in their natural position. Keep your neck neutral and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Roll both shoulders backward in a controlled circular motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. Complete the rotation by returning shoulders to the starting position.

exercises.name: Upper Trapezius Release
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with both feet flat on the floor and maintain neutral posture. Place your right hand across your chest and grasp your left shoulder.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently drop your right ear toward your right shoulder while keeping your left shoulder pressed down with your right hand. Feel the stretch along the left upper trapezius and side of the neck.

exercises.name: Shoulder Blade Protraction
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with arms extended forward at chest height with palms facing inward. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Protract your shoulder blades by rounding your upper back and pushing your hands forward slightly, feeling your shoulder blades spread apart. Return to start position slowly and controlled.

exercises.name: Lying Spinal Twist
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms extended out to the sides in a T position. Keep your shoulders relaxed and pressed into the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lower both knees to one side, rotating your spine and pelvis while keeping your shoulders on the floor. Feel a gentle stretch through your back and hold, then repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.pose_description: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders, elbows locked, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. Your core should be engaged and your shoulder blades slightly retracted.
exercises.end_pose_description: Depress and protract your scapulae by allowing your shoulder blades to spread apart, dropping your chest slightly toward the ground without bending your elbows. Return to the starting position by retracting your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides, palms facing inward. Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground with a neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbows. Lift until your arms are parallel to the ground, squeezing your rear shoulder muscles and upper back at the peak of the movement.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Forearm Pronation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, held close to your side with your palm facing up. Loop the resistance band around your hand and hold the other end under your foot.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces downward against the band resistance. Control the movement and return slowly to the palm-up starting position.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Forearm Supination
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, held close to your side with your palm facing down. Loop the resistance band around your hand and hold the other end under your foot.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces upward against the band resistance. Control the movement and return slowly to the palm-down starting position.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your arm resting in your lap, holding a resistance band looped in your hand. Your fingers are relaxed and extended slightly.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze the band firmly with all your fingers, creating a tight grip. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds, then slowly release to the starting position.

exercises.name: Towel Wrist Rolls
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, holding a small towel with a loose grip. Your wrist is in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly roll your wrist in circles, first clockwise for 10 rotations, then counter-clockwise. Perform the movement smoothly with a gentle, pain-free range of motion.

exercises.name: Supine Knee to Chest
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head neutral and arms at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend one knee and gently pull it toward your chest using both hands, feeling a stretch in your lower back and glutes.

exercises.name: Neck Isometric Hold - Affected Side
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place your hand against the side of your head on the affected side (the side the chin is rotated toward).
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press your head into your hand without allowing any neck movement, creating an isometric contraction. Hold this tension for 5-10 seconds while maintaining relaxed breathing.

exercises.name: Sternocleidomastoid Stretch - Affected Side
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes forward and neck in neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently tilt your head away from the affected side (rotate chin toward the unaffected shoulder) while keeping shoulders down. Feel a stretch along the front and side of the affected neck. Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrugs with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Maintain neutral spine and relaxed neck position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Elevate both shoulders toward your ears in a shrugging motion, hold briefly at the top, then lower back down in a controlled manner. This strengthens the upper trapezius and stabilizer muscles.

exercises.name: Neck Rotation - Active Range of Motion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with good posture, shoulders relaxed, and eyes looking straight ahead. Keep your head level and neutral.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your head to look over one shoulder, moving through your full comfortable range of motion without forcing. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side. Perform controlled, gentle rotations.

exercises.name: Prone Cobras
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down with your forearms on the ground, elbows positioned under your shoulders, and legs extended behind you. Keep your neck neutral and eyes looking down.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press through your forearms to lift your chest off the ground while keeping your pelvis in contact with the floor. Maintain a neutral neck position aligned with your spine. Hold for 5-10 seconds to strengthen postural muscles.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows - Bilateral
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, slight bend in knees, and a dumbbell in each hand hanging at your sides with palms facing inward. Maintain neutral spine with shoulders back and down.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull both dumbbells up toward your chest by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders engaged. Lower dumbbells back down in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Seated Foot Intrinsic Strengthening
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your heel planted on the ground with toes relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl your toes downward to create an arch under the ball of your foot, maintaining heel contact with the floor. Hold the contraction for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Single Leg Balance on Firm Surface
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet together, arms at your sides or extended for light balance. Look straight ahead at a fixed point.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to 90 degrees while maintaining an upright torso. Keep the standing leg straight and engaged.

exercises.name: Calf Raises on Both Feet
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands lightly touching a wall or bar for balance. Keep your weight distributed evenly across both feet.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of both feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as possible. Hold the top position for 1 second before lowering.

exercises.name: Plantar Fascia Stretching with Towel
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended in front of you or draped over your knee. Keep your back straight against the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: Loop a towel or resistance band around the ball of your foot and gently pull your toes toward your shin. Feel a stretch along the bottom of your foot.

exercises.name: Arch Doming Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Stand barefoot with feet hip-width apart, weight evenly distributed, and hands resting on a wall or table for balance. Keep your toes flat on the ground.
exercises.end_pose_description: Without curling your toes, draw the ball of your foot toward your heel to create a dome-shaped arch. Maintain this arch position for 3-5 seconds.

exercises.name: Supine Bridge with Foot Focus
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Position feet parallel with weight on the outer edges.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press through the outer edges of your feet and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Ankle Alphabet
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended or crossed over the opposite knee. Keep your foot relaxed and ready to move.
exercises.end_pose_description: Using your foot as a pointer, write capital letters A through Z in the air using ankle and foot movements. Move slowly and deliberately to strengthen intrinsic foot muscles.

exercises.name: Plantar Fascia Self-Massage
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a chair with one foot flat on the floor. Place a small ball or roller under the arch of your foot.
exercises.end_pose_description: Roll the ball slowly from your heel to your toes along the bottom of your foot, applying gentle to moderate pressure. Spend extra time on tender areas.

exercises.name: Heel Raises - Supported
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or counter with your hands lightly resting on it for balance. Your feet are hip-width apart.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as comfortable, then lower back down with control. Perform this movement slowly and deliberately.

exercises.name: Toe Taps
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Your legs are relaxed and your feet are hip-width apart.
exercises.end_pose_description: While keeping your heels on the ground, tap the balls of your feet up and down in a controlled manner. This strengthens the muscles on the front of the foot.

exercises.name: Adductor Stretching
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both legs extended. Bend one knee and gently pull it toward your chest and across your body.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hold the bent knee across your body, feeling a gentle stretch in the inner thigh and hip region. Keep your opposite leg relaxed on the floor.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright and take a small step forward with one leg, bending that knee into a shallow lunge position. Keep your hands on your hips or a stable surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently push your hips forward, feeling a stretch in the front of the hip and upper thigh of the back leg. Maintain an upright torso throughout.

exercises.name: Seated Groin Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall open to the sides. Hold your feet gently with both hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lean forward slightly from the hips, pressing your elbows gently against your inner thighs to deepen the stretch. Maintain good posture through your spine.

exercises.name: Clam Shells
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent to approximately 45 degrees, feet together. Support your head with your lower arm.
exercises.end_pose_description: Keeping your feet together and lower body stable, rotate your top knee upward like opening a clamshell. Return to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curls with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell between your feet at ankle height. Engage your core and keep your torso stable.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend the knee and curl the dumbbell up toward your glute, keeping the thigh stationary. Return to starting position with control.

exercises.name: Step-Ups with Dumbbell
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a low step or platform, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Step up onto the platform with one leg, driving through your heel and standing fully upright at the top. Step back down with control.

exercises.name: Quadriceps Sets with VMO Focus
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended flat on the floor. Place a small rolled towel under the knee of the working leg.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tighten the thigh muscle above the knee, pushing the back of the knee down into the towel and hold. Keep the knee in slight external rotation to activate the VMO (vastus medialis obliquus).

exercises.name: Shoulder Blade Squeezes (Prone)
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down with arms at your sides, palms facing down, and forehead on a towel. Keep your shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms slightly off the floor, keeping elbows straight. Hold the contraction while maintaining a neutral neck.

exercises.name: Planks with Scapular Control
exercises.pose_description: Begin in a forearm plank position with elbows under shoulders and forearms parallel. Keep your core tight and body in one straight line from head to heels.
exercises.end_pose_description: Hold the plank while consciously depressing and retracting your shoulder blades, avoiding any shoulder hiking or excessive winging. Maintain steady breathing throughout.

exercises.name: Wall Sits with Knee Alignment
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and about 12 inches away from the wall. Engage your core and ensure proper knee alignment.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slide down the wall until your knees reach 60-90 degrees of bend, keeping knees tracking over ankles. Hold the position while maintaining an engaged core and neutral spine.

exercises.name: Tall Kneeling Shoulder Stability
exercises.pose_description: Begin in a tall kneeling position with knees hip-width apart, core engaged, and hands on a stability ball or light medicine ball at chest height. Keep your torso upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly push the ball forward, extending your arms without losing spinal stability or excessive forward lean. Return to start and repeat, maintaining core engagement throughout.

exercises.name: Scapular Stabilization with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended straight ahead. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed away from ears.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping elbows slightly bent. Hold the peak contraction briefly while maintaining neutral spine.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms rest at your sides with palms down.
exercises.end_pose_description: Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while pressing gently outward against the band. Squeeze your glutes at the top while maintaining a neutral spine and controlled breathing.

exercises.name: Prone Shoulder Stabilization
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down with arms extended overhead in a Y position, forehead resting neutrally on a towel. Engage your core to maintain neutral spine.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift your arms slightly off the floor while squeezing your shoulder blades down and back, keeping elbows straight. Hold the lift for 2-3 seconds then lower with control.

exercises.name: Kneeling Core Stability with Band
exercises.pose_description: Kneel upright with hips over knees, holding a resistance band anchored at chest height with both hands in front of your chest. Maintain neutral spine and engaged abdominals.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, extending the band diagonally across your body while keeping your hips stationary. Return to center with control and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around one foot and holding the other end in both hands for tension. Maintain neutral posture with slight knee bend.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl your foot toward your buttocks against the band resistance while keeping your hip stable and thigh vertical. Lower with control to the starting position.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Stability Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor, hips and knees at 90 degrees, and hands resting on your thighs. Maintain neutral spine alignment with shoulders over hips.
exercises.end_pose_description: Take slow, deep breaths while maintaining upright posture, feeling your core muscles engage during exhalation. Focus on stability throughout the movement with no compensatory slouching.

exercises.name: Supine Hip and Knee Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back on a comfortable surface with legs extended and arms at your sides. Keep your head in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly bring one knee up toward your chest, gently hugging the thigh with both hands. Hold for a few seconds, then lower and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Standing Quadriceps Strengthening
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart while holding onto a sturdy chair back for balance. Engage your core and maintain good posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly straighten one leg by tightening the thigh muscle, lifting the foot slightly off the floor. Hold briefly, then lower and repeat on the opposite leg.

exercises.name: Standing Spinal Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands crossed over chest or behind head. Keep your hips still and facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, holding the rotation for a moment to feel the stretch in your mid-back and obliques. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Hip Bridges
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and close to your buttocks. Arms are at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze glutes at the top and lower with control.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges with Hold
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Place arms at sides with palms down for stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift hips toward ceiling, squeezing glutes maximally, and hold for 2-3 seconds before lowering. Focus on controlled movement to protect joints.

exercises.name: Shoulder Blade Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with arms at your sides and elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze your shoulder blades together toward your spine, holding the contraction for 2-3 seconds. Release slowly and repeat for controlled joint protection.

exercises.name: Finger Flexor and Extensor Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearms resting on a table, palms facing down. Keep wrists in neutral position without bending.
exercises.end_pose_description: Make a gentle fist by curling fingers inward, then straighten fingers fully. Perform slowly and deliberately without forcing through pain.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees at 90 degrees. Hold the resistance band anchored under your feet with handles at shoulder height, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the band handles overhead until arms are nearly fully extended, maintaining an upright posture. Lower back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Curl with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Loop the resistance band around one foot and hold the ends in both hands for stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl the banded foot toward your glutes by bending the knee, maintaining tension on the band. Straighten the leg with control back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Press with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with the resistance band wrapped around your mid-back and thorax. Hold the band ends at chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the band forward until arms are nearly fully extended at chest height. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Standing Lateral Leg Raise with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Hands can rest on your hips or a chair for balance.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping toes forward and torso upright. Lower the leg back to center with control.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture. Cross one arm across your body toward the opposite knee.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull your crossed arm toward your body, rotating your torso slightly and feeling a stretch along your outer back and shoulder. Hold this gentle stretch position.

exercises.name: Seated Row with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with legs extended or slightly bent, with the resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends with arms extended forward at chest height.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your body by bending your elbows, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Seated Bicep Curl with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, with the resistance band anchored under your feet. Hold the band handles with arms extended down at your sides, palms facing forward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl the band handles up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows while keeping upper arms stationary. Lower back down with control to the starting position.

exercises.name: Gentle Hand Opening and Closing
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm resting on a table or in your lap. Make a gentle fist with your hand, keeping tension minimal.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly open your hand wide, spreading all fingers apart gently. Hold for 2 seconds before returning to the starting fist position.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion and Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Keep your hand relaxed in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently bend your wrist upward, then slowly lower it downward past neutral. Move only within a pain-free range.

exercises.name: Finger Desensitization Tapping
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm supported on a table. Rest your fingers flat on the table surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently tap each finger individually on the table in sequence, then tap all fingers together. Use light pressure to gradually desensitize the skin.

exercises.name: Active Range of Motion Arm Circles
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
exercises.end_pose_description: Make small circles forward with both arms, gradually increasing the size. Reverse direction and make circles backward at a comfortable pace.

exercises.name: Gentle Palm Pressing
exercises.pose_description: Sit with both hands placed flat on a table in front of you, fingers spread naturally. Keep your wrists in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press your palms and fingers into the table with light pressure, engaging the muscles without causing pain. Hold for 2 seconds and release.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Your core is engaged and your back maintains a neutral position against the chair.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner until your arms are nearly fully extended. Your shoulders remain stable and engaged throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat, arms hanging at your sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Your elbows stay close to your torso throughout the movement.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl the dumbbells upward by bending your elbows, bringing the weights toward your shoulders in a controlled manner. Your upper arms remain stationary while only your forearms move.

exercises.name: Prone Dumbbell Rows
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or sturdy surface with dumbbells on the ground beneath your shoulders, arms extended. Your core is engaged and your neck remains neutral, looking slightly downward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbells upward toward your ribcage, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your back muscles are fully engaged at the top of the movement.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Your core is engaged and your posture is upright.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a controlled motion until your arms are approximately parallel to the ground at shoulder height. Your elbows maintain a slight bend throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Rotation Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands crossed over your chest. Your spine is tall and your shoulders are relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently rotate your torso to one side, allowing your shoulders to follow the movement while keeping your hips facing forward. Hold the stretch feeling the muscles along your back and torso lengthen.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Goblet Squats
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands cupping the top end. Your chest is up, core engaged, and weight distributed evenly across your feet.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lower your body by bending your knees and hips as if sitting into a chair, keeping the dumbbell at chest height. Your knees track over your toes and your chest remains upright throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Towel
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Hold a towel roll or small foam roller horizontally across your chest at shoulder height with both hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly raise the towel up and back over your head in an arc, keeping elbows slightly bent and moving only as far as comfortable. Return to starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Seated Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture. Bring your affected arm across your body at shoulder height.
exercises.end_pose_description: Use your opposite hand to gently pull your affected arm closer to your chest, feeling a stretch across the back of the shoulder. Hold the stretch position steady and breathe deeply.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder External Rotation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with back supported and feet flat. Hold a resistance band with elbows bent 90 degrees at your sides and palms facing inward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms outward against band resistance, keeping elbows stationary at your sides. Return slowly to starting position and repeat with controlled movement.

exercises.name: Supine Bridge with Shoulder Engagement
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down and elbows slightly bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press through your feet to lift hips toward the ceiling while pressing your arms into the mat to engage shoulder stabilizers. Hold at the top position while maintaining neutral spine alignment.

exercises.name: Kneeling Quadruped Shoulder Reaches
exercises.pose_description: Start in a quadruped position on hands and knees with shoulders directly over wrists and hips over knees. Maintain a neutral spine throughout.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly reach your affected arm forward and slightly across your body, extending through the shoulder while keeping your torso stable. Return to starting position and repeat.

exercises.name: Shoulder Flexion with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band under both feet with handles in each hand at your sides. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly raise both arms forward and upward to shoulder height, keeping the band taut and resisting its tension. Lower arms back to the starting position with controlled movement.

exercises.name: Shoulder Abduction with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, standing on a resistance band with both feet while holding the handles at your sides. Keep your arms relaxed and your core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, maintaining tension in the band throughout the movement. Slowly lower your arms back down in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Elbow Flexion Curls with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand on a resistance band with both feet, holding one handle in each hand with arms extended straight down at your sides. Keep your elbows close to your body and maintain an upright posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend your elbows and curl both hands up toward your shoulders, keeping the band tension consistent and elbows stationary. Slowly lower your arms back to full extension.

exercises.name: Finger Flexion and Extension with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably and place a resistance band looped around all four fingers of one hand with the band anchored under your foot or held in the opposite hand. Your fingers should be in a relaxed, extended position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl your fingers inward, flexing against the band resistance while keeping your palm flat. Slowly extend your fingers back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Horizontal Adduction with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart while holding a resistance band anchored at shoulder height in front of you. Extend both arms out to the sides at shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull both arms together in front of your chest, squeezing your chest muscles against the band tension. Slowly return to the starting position with arms extended out to the sides.

exercises.name: Lymphatic Drainage Arm Raises
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with your arms at your sides, keeping your shoulders relaxed and your core engaged. This is a gentle, controlled movement focused on promoting lymphatic flow.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly raise both arms overhead in a smooth, flowing motion, then lower them back down gently to your sides. Perform this movement slowly and deliberately to encourage lymphatic drainage upward toward the trunk.

exercises.name: Neck Lateral Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Keep both feet flat on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a stretch on the left side of the neck. Return to center and repeat on the left side.

exercises.name: Supine Shoulder Internal Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Position the affected shoulder at 90 degrees with elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing upward.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently lower the forearm across your body toward the floor, feeling a stretch across the front and back of the shoulder. Hold gently without forcing the movement.

exercises.name: Seated Scapular Squeezes
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with arms relaxed at your sides and shoulders in neutral position. Keep your chest open and shoulders pulled back slightly.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and slightly downward, creating tension in the upper back. Hold briefly and release, maintaining a controlled movement.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your eyes looking straight ahead.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to the right, trying to bring your chin toward your shoulder while maintaining an upright posture. Hold briefly and return to center, then repeat on the left.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges with Dumbbells
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with feet together. Take a controlled step forward with your right leg.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lower your body by bending both knees until your back knee nearly touches the ground and your front thigh is parallel to the floor. Push off your front foot to step forward with your opposite leg.

exercises.name: Quadruped Bird Dogs
exercises.pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core gently engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Simultaneously extend your right arm forward and left leg backward, creating a straight line from fingertips to heel. Return to starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Chest Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with good posture, feet hip-width apart. Clasp your hands behind your back with arms extended.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your hands slightly away from your body, feeling a stretch across your chest. Hold this stretch position, breathing deeply.

exercises.name: Single Leg Stance with Upper Body Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a sturdy gym railing or wall with fingertips lightly touching for support. Feet are hip-width apart with weight evenly distributed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift one foot slightly off the ground while maintaining light contact with the support. Keep your core engaged and gaze fixed on a stable point ahead.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance with Wall Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand sideways next to a wall with your hand lightly resting on it for balance. Position feet parallel and hip-width apart.
exercises.end_pose_description: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe line while maintaining light hand contact on the wall. Keep your body upright and core engaged.

exercises.name: Calf Raises with Handrail Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a gym railing with both hands holding it for support. Feet are hip-width apart with weight distributed evenly through all toes.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining steady contact with the railing. Lower heels back down with control.

exercises.name: Proprioceptive Foot Taps on Ground
exercises.pose_description: Stand with one hand lightly touching a stable surface for balance. Weight is on one leg while the other leg is ready to perform taps.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently tap your toes and heel sequentially on the ground while standing on one leg, creating a rhythmic pattern. Maintain focus on foot placement and sensory feedback.

exercises.name: Wall Sits with Sensory Focus
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Hands are at your sides or on your thighs.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slide down the wall into a squat position with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, keeping your back flat against the wall. Focus on feeling muscle engagement in your thighs and glutes.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Rail Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand sideways next to a gym railing with the near hand holding it lightly for balance. Feet are hip-width apart with weight on the standing leg.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift the outer leg out to the side in a controlled manner, maintaining a slight forward lean from the hips. Lower the leg back down with control without rotating your torso.

exercises.name: Seated Shin Taps with Foot Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a bench with feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart. Back is straight and hands rest on thighs for stability.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tap your toes repeatedly on the ground by flexing your feet at the ankles, lifting your heel while keeping the ball of the foot in contact with the floor. Perform the movement slowly with deliberate control.

exercises.name: Seated Upper Body Band Pull-Apart
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended straight out in front of you.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward in an arc, bringing the band to chest level with elbows slightly bent. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end position.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Stand on a resistance band with both feet and hold the ends in each hand at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise both arms forward and upward to shoulder height, keeping elbows slightly bent. Return to starting position with controlled movement.

exercises.name: Supine Chest Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back on a mat with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band across your chest with both hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press the band outward and across your body, allowing your chest to open and stretch. Hold this position, feeling a gentle stretch across the front of your chest.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Internal Rotation with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band with elbows bent at 90 degrees, upper arms at your sides.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms inward toward your body against the band resistance. Return to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Flexion with Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot and hold the other end with your hands.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift the banded leg by raising the knee up toward your chest against the band resistance. Lower back down with control and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Supine Lower Back Stretch with Band
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one knee.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull the banded knee toward your chest and across your body, creating a stretch through your lower back and hip. Hold the stretch position, breathing deeply.

exercises.name: Ankle Pumps
exercises.pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your thighs parallel to the ground.
exercises.end_pose_description: Point your toes downward as far as comfortable, then pull your toes toward your shins. Move through the full range of motion smoothly.

exercises.name: Supine Glute Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the bed, positioned hip-width apart. Rest your arms at your sides with palms down.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze the buttock muscles tightly while keeping your back pressed to the bed. Hold the contraction for 3-5 seconds before relaxing.

exercises.name: Seated Arm Lifts (Supine)
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with arms at your sides, palms facing down, and elbows slightly bent. Keep your chest open and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly slide both arms up along your sides toward your head, lifting only to shoulder height without crossing the sternal midline. Return arms to starting position.

exercises.name: Supine Breathing Exercises
exercises.pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and a pillow under your head for comfort. Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4, allowing your belly to rise while keeping your chest relaxed. Exhale through your mouth for a count of 4.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Press - Seated
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with back support, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Feet are flat on the floor with knees at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells forward and slightly upward until arms are nearly extended without locking the elbows. Return to start position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls - Standing
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides holding light dumbbells with palms facing forward. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged and knees slightly bent.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders by bending the elbows while keeping upper arms stationary. Lower back to starting position with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises - Seated
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with back support, holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Feet are flat on the floor.
exercises.end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows. Slowly lower them back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows - Seated
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with back support, holding a light dumbbell in one hand with arm extended downward. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip by bending the elbow and squeezing the back muscle. Return to starting position with control and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walking with Interval Training
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright on the treadmill with feet hip-width apart and hands lightly gripping the handrails. Begin at a slow, comfortable walking pace to warm up.
exercises.end_pose_description: Increase the treadmill speed to a moderate intensity where conversation is difficult but possible, maintaining an upright posture. Continue at this increased pace for the interval duration.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike with Resistance
exercises.pose_description: Sit on the bike seat with feet flat on the pedals, hands on the handlebars, and back upright. Adjust the seat height so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
exercises.end_pose_description: Pedal at a moderate to brisk pace against moderate resistance, maintaining steady breathing and an upright posture. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Seated Marching with Arm Circles
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides. Maintain an upright posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift one knee up while performing large circular motions with both arms overhead. Alternate knees in a marching rhythm while continuing smooth arm circles for controlled cardiovascular engagement.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Wall Support
exercises.pose_description: Stand sideways next to a wall or sturdy rail with your hand lightly touching it for balance. Keep your standing leg straight and engaged, with your other leg relaxed at your side.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lift your outer leg out to the side, keeping your toes pointing forward and your torso upright. Hold at the top briefly, then lower your leg back down with control.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch with Wall
exercises.pose_description: Stand facing a wall with one hand lightly touching it for balance. Keep your standing leg straight and engaged with good posture.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend your opposite knee and bring your heel toward your buttock, holding your ankle gently with your hand. Keep your knees aligned and maintain an upright torso while holding the stretch.

exercises.name: Pursed-Lip Breathing during Light Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright in a relaxed position with shoulders back and feet hip-width apart. Focus on your normal breathing pattern.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 2, then exhale slowly through pursed lips for a count of 4, as if blowing through a straw. Maintain this controlled breathing pattern during light walking or movement.

exercises.name: Supported Squats to Chair
exercises.pose_description: Stand in front of a sturdy chair with feet hip-width apart and hands resting lightly on the chair back for support. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Lower your hips back and down as if sitting into the chair, keeping your weight in your heels and knees tracking over your toes. Tap the chair seat lightly and return to standing by pushing through your heels.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Press
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Loop the resistance band under your feet and hold the ends at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press the band upward and outward, extending your arms overhead while maintaining control. Return to the starting position with a slow, controlled movement.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Sets with Band
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or sturdy support with one hand lightly resting on it for balance. Loop the resistance band around your thigh just above the knee.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tighten your quadriceps muscle and straighten your leg by tightening the thigh muscles against the band resistance. Hold the contraction briefly, then relax while keeping your leg straight.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Twist Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and your back against the chair. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your core gently engaged.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently twist your torso to one side, placing your right hand on your left knee while your left hand rests behind you. Hold the stretch gently, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Blade Squeezes
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides with palms facing backward. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your chest open.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze your shoulder blades together toward your spine, pulling your elbows slightly backward. Hold the contraction briefly, feeling the muscles between your shoulder blades engage, then release.

exercises.name: Seated Box Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your hands resting on your lap.
exercises.end_pose_description: Complete a breathing cycle: inhale for 4 counts, hold for 4 counts, exhale for 4 counts, hold for 4 counts. Repeat the pattern with controlled, deliberate breathing.

exercises.name: Chest Wall Mobility Stretch
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and clasp your hands behind your back at waist level. Keep your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press your hands downward and straighten your arms while lifting your chest upward and opening your shoulders. Hold this position while taking slow, deep breaths.

exercises.name: Prone Cobra Breathing
exercises.pose_description: Lie face down with your forehead resting on the back of your hands, elbows tucked close to your body. Keep your legs extended and relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale deeply and gently lift your head and upper chest slightly off the floor using minimal arm support. Exhale fully as you return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Pursed-Lip Breathing Walk
exercises.pose_description: Stand upright with good posture and feet shoulder-width apart. Begin walking at a comfortable, slow pace.
exercises.end_pose_description: While walking, inhale through your nose for 2-4 steps, then exhale slowly through pursed lips for 4-6 steps. Maintain steady, controlled breathing throughout the walk.

exercises.name: Belly Breathing with Leg Lifts
exercises.pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands on your belly. Focus on breathing into your diaphragm.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale deeply through your nose, then exhale while slowly straightening one leg and extending it along the floor. Inhale to return, then repeat on the opposite side.

exercises.name: Standing Rib Expansion
exercises.pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands gently on the sides of your rib cage. Keep your posture upright and relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Inhale deeply through your nose, expanding your ribs outward and to the sides while resisting gently with your hands. Exhale slowly and feel your ribs return to neutral position.

exercises.name: Intrinsic Hand Strengthening
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand open with fingers spread apart and relaxed. Keep your palm and wrist in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Make a claw shape by bending only the middle and end knuckles while keeping the base knuckles straight. Squeeze gently to engage the small intrinsic muscles of the hand.

exercises.name: Palmar Fascia Stretching
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright and use your opposite hand to gently grasp the affected hand at the base of the fingers. Your hand should be relaxed and supported.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently extend the fingers backward toward the top of your hand, creating a stretch through the palm. Hold the stretch without forcing, maintaining gentle tension through the fascia.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening Progressive
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright holding a soft stress ball or therapy putty in your affected hand with fingers extended. Your hand should be relaxed and ready to engage.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze the ball or putty with all your fingers gradually increasing pressure. Hold the squeeze for 3-5 seconds at a comfortable intensity, then release slowly.

exercises.name: Finger Tapping Exercise
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your hand relaxed and flat on a table, fingers extended naturally. Your hand should be completely supported and at rest.
exercises.end_pose_description: Tap each finger individually against the table in sequence from index to pinky, then back again. Perform this movement continuously with controlled, moderate speed to improve individual finger mobility.

exercises.name: DIP (Finger) Flexion and Extension
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. The affected finger hangs off the edge of the table while other fingers remain flat on the surface.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly bend the DIP joint (tip of finger) downward, then straighten it back to neutral. Move only at the DIP joint while keeping the PIP joint stable.

exercises.name: PIP Joint Passive Range of Motion
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your affected hand resting on a table, palm up. Use your other hand to gently support the finger at the base.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently bend the PIP joint (middle knuckle) to approximately 45 degrees, holding for 2 seconds without forcing. Return slowly to neutral position.

exercises.name: Intrinsic Hand Muscle Activation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your hand relaxed on a table, fingers extended and slightly spread. Keep your metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints straight while preparing to curl the other joints.
exercises.end_pose_description: Flex only the PIP and DIP joints to make a claw-like position while keeping MCP joints extended. Hold for 5 seconds, maintaining the splint position on the affected finger.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Therapy Putty
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow flexed to 90 degrees and hold a ball of therapy putty in your palm. Keep your fingers extended over the putty.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly curl all fingers into a fist, pressing the putty firmly while protecting the splinted DIP joint. Hold for 3 seconds then release, repeating for 10 repetitions.

exercises.name: Pronation and Supination Rotation
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and forearm supported on a table, starting with your palm facing down. Keep your elbow stationary against the table throughout the movement.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supination), then reverse to palm down (pronation). Move through the full range of motion slowly and controlled.

exercises.name: Forearm Isometric Strengthening
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table with your palm facing down. Keep your hand in neutral position with fingers extended and splint in place.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press your forearm down firmly into the table without moving, generating tension in the forearm muscles. Hold this contraction for 10 seconds, rest, and repeat 8-10 times.

exercises.name: Shoulder Circles for Upper Body Mobility
exercises.pose_description: Stand with your arms at your sides, feet shoulder-width apart, maintaining good posture. Relax your shoulders and let your arms hang naturally.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly roll both shoulders backward in a circular motion, then reverse to roll forward. Complete 10 circles in each direction with controlled, fluid movements.

exercises.name: Thumb Opposition Isometric Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your thumb is relaxed and in a neutral position away from your fingers.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently press your thumb pad against your index finger pad while applying light resistance with your other hand. Hold this position without movement.

exercises.name: Grip Strengthening with Band Squeeze
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on your lap, holding a resistance band in your hand with all fingers and thumb relaxed around it. Your elbow is bent at 90 degrees.
exercises.end_pose_description: Squeeze the band firmly with your entire hand, including your thumb, for a maximum contraction. Hold the squeeze while maintaining thumb stability without allowing it to bend excessively.

exercises.name: Thumb IP Joint Flexion Hold
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your hand resting palm-up on a table, with your thumb extended and straight. Your other hand is ready to provide gentle resistance at the thumb tip.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend only the tip joint of your thumb while your other hand provides light resistance. Hold this position, focusing on isolated movement at the interphalangeal joint.

exercises.name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Stretch with Band Assist
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up, using a resistance band looped around your hand for gentle assistance. Your wrist is in a neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently pull your hand toward your forearm using the band, creating a stretch along the back of your wrist and forearm. Hold this comfortable stretch position, ensuring your thumb remains relaxed.

exercises.name: Isolated Thumb MCP Joint Stabilization
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm down, with a light resistance band wrapped loosely around your thumb and index finger. Your thumb is in a relaxed neutral position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Press your thumb against the light band resistance while keeping your MCP (middle) joint stable and slightly flexed. The UCL ligament is protected by maintaining this supported position throughout.

exercises.name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band Alternative (Towel Roll)
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Place a small towel roll under your fingers just below the knuckles.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly straighten your fingers by lifting them upward against the resistance of the towel. Hold briefly at full extension without locking your joints.

exercises.name: PIP Joint Isolation Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table with palm facing down. Keep the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints straight while allowing only the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints to flex.
exercises.end_pose_description: Bend only the middle joint of your finger downward in a controlled motion. Hold this position for 2 seconds before slowly returning to straight.

exercises.name: DIP Joint Active Motion
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down. Keep the MCP and PIP joints stationary while focusing on the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently curl only the fingertip downward by bending the DIP joint. Perform small, controlled movements without forcing or straining the joint.

exercises.name: Gentle Finger Stretching
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected hand resting palm-down on a table. Use your other hand to gently grasp the affected finger.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly and gently pull the finger into slight extension without pain. Hold the mild stretch for 15-20 seconds, then release gradually.

exercises.name: Intrinsic Hand Muscle Activation (Lumbrical Exercise)
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand open and relaxed with fingers extended. Position your hand in a neutral posture with the palm facing sideways.
exercises.end_pose_description: Curl only the lower knuckles (MCP joints) downward while keeping the middle and top joints straight. This creates a claw-like position that activates the intrinsic muscles.

exercises.name: Forearm Pronation and Supination
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your side, forearm at neutral with palm facing downward. Keep your upper arm stationary throughout.
exercises.end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supination), then rotate back and turn palm downward (pronation). Move slowly through the full available range.

exercises.name: Grip Strength Maintenance (Soft Object)
exercises.pose_description: Sit comfortably holding a soft sponge or cloth in your hand with fingers relaxed and slightly curled. Maintain a neutral wrist position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Gently squeeze the soft object using all your fingers for a 3-5 second hold at mild intensity. Release slowly and rest before repeating.

exercises.name: Active Range of Motion Finger Straightening
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm down, allowing your fingers to naturally curl slightly. Begin from a relaxed, partially flexed position.
exercises.end_pose_description: Actively straighten all your fingers fully by engaging your finger extensor muscles. Hold the fully extended position briefly, then return to the starting relaxed position.

exercises.name: Intrinsic Hand Strengthening - Finger Flexion
exercises.pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up with fingers extended. Your wrist is in neutral position with the repaired hand relaxed.
exercises.end_pose_description: Slowly curl only your fingers (not wrist) into a fist, bringing fingertips toward your palm. Hold the contracted position briefly before returning to full extension.

exercises.name: Thumb Opposition with Resistance Band
exercises.pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand in neutral position with fingers extended. Loop a resistance band around your thumb and index finger.
